job_description:
**Job Description: Product Manager – CONSTRA**

Company: Bandhoo

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–3 years

**About Bandhoo**

Bandhoo is a technology-driven company building SaaS solutions for construction project execution and workforce management.

**About CONSTRA**

CONSTRA is a construction intelligence platform using drone analytics, 360° camera walkthroughs, Scan-to-BIM, and AI-powered visual monitoring to help track construction progress and quality.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager – CONSTRA to take ownership of CONSTRA. You will work with engineering, design, and business teams to understand user needs, define product requirements, and deliver useful product improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the CONSTRA product roadmap and priorities in collaboration with the CTO and leadership team.

· Manage the product lifecycle from discovery and requirements gathering to prioritisation, development, release, and continuous improvement.

· Drive AI-enabled product features, including LLM-based agents for safety, defect detection, and project progress tracking.

· Work on analytics, dashboards, and workflows that help construction teams monitor project status and quality.

· Engage with site engineers, project managers, and customers to understand on-site challenges and improve product usability.

· Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria; coordinate with engineering and design teams during development.

· Support sprint planning, review product builds, prioritise bugs, and help deliver releases on time.

· Work with sales and business teams on product launches, go-to-market activities, and customer feedback.

· Track product adoption, engagement, retention, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

Interact with customers for smooth rollout of product features.

**Requirements**

· 1–3 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, ConstructionTech, PropTech, or technology-driven products.

· Ability to translate user and business needs into clear product requirements.

· Understanding of agile product development and the software development lifecycle.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Exposure to AI-enabled products, construction technology, GIS, BIM, drone analytics, or visual analytics.

· Familiarity with mobile apps for field teams or offline environments.

· Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, PostHog, or Amplitude.

· A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Architecture, or a related field.

**What We’re Looking For**

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Clear communication and collaboration skills.

· A proactive approach, ownership mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

**Title:** **Assistant Product Manager**
========================================

Date: Oct 15, 2026

Location: Sun House - Corporate Office

Company: Sun Pharma Laboratories Ltd

**Title:**

Assistant Product Manager (Croslands)

**Business Unit:**

Dermatology

  

**Location:**

Sun House, Mumbai

  
  
  

At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you **“Create your own sunshine”**— by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community.

Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?

  

As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”

  

**Job Summary:**

  

As a Group Product Manager (GPM) within Marketing, you will usually be office based. The role encompasses marketing and sales in collaboration with commercial management, headquarters (product brand planning), sales management, market access management, medical management, registration colleagues, communication agencies, and market advice groups. They also manage the Product Life Cycle (PLC) of Brands.

**Key responsibilities:**

Development, collaboration, implementation, & accountability for strategic and operational plans which optimize profitability, market share, and revenue growth for a brand portfolio in the short and long term. Applicant to lead various assignments to help the BU meet overall BU business goals

* Development of marketing and promotional plans for products to support the end consumer’s need
* Monitor business performance and support the portfolio with the help of regular tracking
* Market intelligence through primary research and customer connect
* Writing and executing strategic business and marketing plans in collaboration with important prescribers, opinion leaders, round tables, and other advisory groups
* Joint financial responsibility for budgets (advertising and promotion, conferences and symposia, sales brochures and other product documentation, website content, literature), as well as analysis of budget income and costs;
* initiating and coordinating marketing activities and projects
* Presentation to staff and training field staff for the same
* Visiting national and international congresses, hospitals, and key opinion leaders (KOLs);
* Translating the corporate brand strategy in close collaboration with headquarters, together with logos and visuals, working with corporate product budgets (approval for expenditure on projects, local communication strategies), and providing input into corporate product strategy;
* Discussion partner for first, second, and third-line professionals such as general practitioners, medical specialists, pharmacists, and other medical professionals, and for other DMU members (decision-making units) such as local and national formulary committees and insurance companies;
* Organizing advisory councils, acting as a discussion leader or chairman, or giving product presentations.
* Collaboration with internal & external media to ensure the proper execution of strategies

  

**Travel Estimate**

5-6 days in a month

  

**Job Requirements**

  

**Educational Qualification**

B. Pharm / M. Pharm & MBA

  

**Experience**

4-10 years

  

* Preferred background in clinical dermatology with a robust understanding of therapeutic trends.
* Extensive experience building and maintaining strategic relationships with Dermatologists and key HCP stakeholders.

* Demonstrable success in marketing or sales; strategic insight;
* Effective networking skills and planning ability;
* creativity and persuasiveness;
* Analytical and conceptual strength, strong and inspiring personality;
* self-starting and entrepreneurial.

**Your Success Matters to Us**

  

At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. *Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. Let’s create a brighter future together!*

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees as assigned to this job. Nothing herein shall preclude the employer from changing these duties from time to time and assigning comparable duties or other duties commensurate with the experience and background of incumbent(s).*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

**What we do...**

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

**About the Product Manager role...**

This is a full-stack product role with a primary focus on GDS connectivity within the distribution portfolio. You will lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and opportunity identification through requirements definition, delivery, go-to-market, and post-launch evaluation. Working closely with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional engineering teams, you will shape product direction, support feature delivery, and define clear success measures to ensure outcomes align with customer needs and business goals.

**What you'll do...**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and customer validation through requirements definition, delivery, launch, and evaluation.
* Shape and execute the product roadmap in alignment with customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer-centred research and business analysis with hoteliers, connectivity partners, and internal subject matter experts.
* Identify, define, prioritise, and validate product opportunities, features, and enhancements.
* Partner with the Design and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, shape solutions, and support effective delivery.
* Prioritise and maintain the product backlog, ensuring the team remains focused on the highest-value work.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to plan releases, manage dependencies, and communicate progress and milestones.
* Support go-to-market planning, product positioning, internal enablement, and customer and partner communications.
* Define and monitor success metrics, including adoption, customer satisfaction, revenue impact, delivery performance, product-market fit, and operational quality.
* Stay informed on market, customer, competitor, and technology developments, including the effective use of AI tools and AI-augmented workflows.

**What you'll have...**

* 5+ years’ product management experience in B2B SaaS, travel, hospitality technology, or a related domain.
* Experience in hotel distribution, channel management, revenue management, connectivity, GDS integrations, or another travel-related domain is highly desirable.
* Experience working with API-based products, system integrations, and cross-functional delivery teams in Agile or Kanban environments.
* A proven track record of delivering products or features that achieve customer adoption, commercial outcomes, and measurable business value.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and technical business analysis skills, with confidence using customer insights and data to inform decisions.
* Creative and adaptable problem-solving skills, with the ability to think outside the box, develop practical solutions to complex challenges, and demonstrably leverage AI tools and capabilities to accelerate outcomes.
* A solid understanding of product management practices and the end-to-end product lifecycle, with the ability to operate in ambiguity and make pragmatic trade-offs across customer, commercial, technical, and operational considerations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional workshops and build collaborative relationships across geographically distributed teams.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally to meet customers, connectivity partners, and internal stakeholders, including at our head office in Sydney, Australia.

**Our Perks & Benefits…**

* Mental health and well-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

Think this role sounds like you? If so, we’d love to hear from you. Please send us your resume and our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

When you apply, feel free to share your pronouns and let us know if you need any adjustments during the interview process, we’re here to support you. We also warmly encourage applications from people from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

As a Product Manager in Consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations.

**Job responsibilities**

* Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and priorities for enterprise data platform capabilities.
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions that support business, analytics, and AI use cases.
* Gather customer and stakeholder feedback to identify platform enhancements, emerging needs, and innovation opportunities.
* Create and manage product backlogs, requirements, and success metrics.
* Drive adoption of modern data engineering practices and cloud-native platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with data scientists, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure data platforms support AI and machine learning workloads.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform product strategy and investment decisions & Define measurable business outcomes and monitor product performance against established objectives.
* Communicate product vision, roadmap progress, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership & Support planning, prioritization, and execution of platform modernization initiatives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in in Product Management, Technology, Data Platforms, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts and modern platform architectures & Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale technology or data platform products.
* Experience working with large-scale data processing, data integration, analytics, or data platform solutions.
* Familiarity with modern data engineering technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Databricks, or similar distributed processing frameworks.
* Experience with enterprise data platforms, data lakes, metadata management, or data governance solutions.
* Understanding of machine learning concepts and AI-enabled business capabilities & Experience supporting products, platforms, or solutions used for analytics, machine learning, or generative AI workloads.
* Ability to define product requirements that enable AI-ready data assets, model development, or data-driven decision makin & Familiarity with modern AI ecosystem concepts such as MLOps, feature engineering, model lifecycle management, or AI governance.
* Experience partnering with engineering and data science teams to deliver AI-enabled capabilities & Knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or related AI technologies.

  
  
  
**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
LocationSan Francisco, Bangalore, or Seattle

Employment typeFull-time

Location typeIn-person

DepartmentProduct

Commenda is building the agent for global legal and tax work. Teams use it to register entities, manage obligations, and stay compliant globally. Today that work requires additional headcount, local vendors, and disconnected systems.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn complex legal, tax, and operational work into reliable, agentic products. You’ll define how agents use company context, interpret requirements, take action, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You’ll work directly with customers, engineers, domain experts, and operations to build products that deliver compliance outcomes.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

**Build agents that get compliance work done.** Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

**Make agent behavior measurable and reliable.** Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios and edge cases. You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

**Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior.** Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

**Build and improve workflows yourself.** Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

**Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together.** Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

**Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize.** Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **At least two years of product management experience**, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
* **Hands-on experience with AI evaluations.** You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
* **Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.** These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
* **Strong judgment about agentic user experiences.** You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
* **Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence.** You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
* **Strong ownership and organizational skills.** You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
* **A willingness to get into the details.** You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
* **Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel.** You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
* **Curiosity and rigor in complex domains.** You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

**About the team**
------------------

We’re an ambitious, intense team spread across Bangalore, San Francisco, and Seattle. We work like a sports team: we practice, challenge each other, and take shared responsibility for winning. People here move quickly, form their own opinions, and take on problems without waiting to be assigned them.

AI is part of how we build every day. You’ll work alongside engineers and domain experts who use agents to tackle complex work, experiment with new tools, and push what the product can do. We value curiosity, imagination, and the willingness to turn an unconventional idea into something customers can use.

You’ll have real ownership early, direct access to the people making decisions, and room to grow as you prove what you can take on.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Health insurance.
* A monthly self-improvement stipend for learning, fitness, or other investments in your development.
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration with colleagues across our global offices.
* A collaborative office environment and team events.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two-sided commerce network: 15,000+ brands and 3,500+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at www.syndigo.com.

**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Bangalore location\*\***

We are looking for a **Product Manager** who embraces an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), using AI throughout the product lifecycle to accelerate innovation, improve product quality, and deliver measurable customer outcomes. You will use AIDLC to lead the strategy and execution of capabilities across our Product Experience Management (PXM) platform while identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve data quality, and enhance customer productivity at scale.

**HOW WE'LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**

* Define functional and non-functional requirements and recommend solutions in the form of POCs, prototypes, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to groom stories and iterate on prototypes throughout the release cycle.
* Act as a proxy for the business throughout development, testing, and release activities to ensure business needs are met.
* Develop business analysis artifacts, such as business rules and process flows, to clarify requirements.
* Coordinate with other departments in advance of feature and product launches to develop messaging that supports and promotes new releases, features, and updates.
* Conduct product training internally and externally, including training internal trainers, developing new product and feature documentation, and introducing new functionality to internal employees and key customers.
* Provide consistency and clarity to development projects by identifying business needs and constraints, defining scope, and ensuring efficient execution.
* Design product processes that move initiatives forward using AI tooling.
* Advance the use of AI and autonomous agents to transform and accelerate the product development lifecycle.

**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU**

* 4–5 years of Product Management experience building and scaling enterprise SaaS products.
* Proven experience operating within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), leveraging AI across discovery, requirements, design, delivery, and product optimization.
* Demonstrated track record of defining, launching, and scaling AI-powered features, agents, automation workflows, or intelligent recommendation systems.
* Hands-on experience using Generative AI and LLM-based tools to accelerate product management workflows, improve decision-making, and increase team productivity.
* Strong understanding of AI product patterns, including LLMs, RAG, AI agents, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
* Ability to identify high-value automation opportunities and translate them into measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Data-driven mindset with experience defining success metrics, evaluating AI outcomes, and driving continuous product improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, implementation-ready product requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to lead cross-functional teams without formal authority.
* Experience in PIM, PXM, DAM, Syndication, eCommerce, Retail, CPG, Manufacturing, or Distribution domains (preferred but not required).

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**
---------------------------------

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it's how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

**GDPR/CCPA**

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

**Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice**

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Lead Product Manager
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a **Lead Product Manager** within the Commercial Bank to serve as a Product Owner responsible for driving execution of strategic product initiatives and delivering customer and business value through agile product teams. This role will partner closely with Product Managers, Technology Leaders, Architects, Operations, Risk, and business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into actionable product capabilities, ensuring successful delivery of solutions that meet customer needs, regulatory requirements, and operational objectives.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead one or more product teams in delivering business and customer value through execution of product initiatives aligned with established product strategies and roadmaps.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs, risk requirements, and regulatory commitments.
* Collaborate with L2/L3 Product Managers and stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into actionable epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Drive backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, product reviews, and demonstrations to ensure effective execution and delivery.
* Partner with technology, architecture, operations, and business teams to define solutions and ensure successful implementation of product enhancements and capabilities.
* Facilitate prioritization decisions across competing demands while balancing customer value, operational efficiency, technical dependencies, and regulatory requirements.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies, identify delivery risks, remove impediments, and drive timely resolution of issues impacting product delivery.
* Validate business requirements and acceptance criteria to ensure delivered solutions meet customer expectations, quality standards, and business objectives.
* Monitor product area performance, user adoption, operational outcomes, and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support process automation, AI-enabled capabilities, and modernization initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational effectiveness.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Control partners to ensure solutions adhere to enterprise policies, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements.
* Communicate product priorities, delivery progress, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Drive a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and Agile best practices across the product team.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to junior Product Owners and team members while promoting effective product management practices.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or equivalent experience.
* Experience leading Agile product delivery teams and managing backlogs within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, business requirements, and release planning activities.
* Experience working closely with engineers, architects, designers, and business stakeholders to deliver technology solutions.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments across multiple workstreams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience using Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to influence outcomes and drive execution in matrixed organizational environments.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in Commercial Banking, Supply Chain Finance, Lending, Receivables Finance, Treasury Management, Payments, or related banking domains.
* Experience supporting platform modernization, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Knowledge of banking regulatory, risk, and control frameworks.
* Experience with SQL, Power BI, data analytics, and reporting tools.
* Familiarity with AI, Generative AI, intelligent automation, and data-driven product decision making.
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and modern product operating models.

**Posting End Date:**

19 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
The Senior Product Manager owns the strategy, design, and delivery of products within the Private Funds domain of the Clearwater system. The role covers the full product lifecycle, from defining the product and planning development through production and go-to-market. You will build the product roadmap needed to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets for your component.

This is a technical product role. You will work with engineering on data models, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, and you will be a domain authority on how private funds are structured, reported, and valued. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new capabilities, partner with development teams to build and launch them, and pilot new features with clients before promoting them to the wider client base.

**Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership:** Lead and guide a team of 8-15 developers, supporting knowledge-sharing and training to build team effectiveness.
* **Product Ownership:** Own the Private Funds product(s) end to end, from ideation through market launch and ongoing evolution.
* **Backlog Management:** Prioritize and manage the backlog, balancing client-facing features, data quality, and platform investments in line with business goals.
* **Technical Requirement Definition:** Write clear, detailed requirements and acceptance criteria, including data model changes, schema definitions, API contracts, validation rules, and data lineage expectations.
* **Private Funds Data Modeling:** Define and evolve the domain data model, including GP/LP structures, master/feeder relationships, fund and asset taxonomies and sub-types, and the treatment of capital account and PCAP statements, capital call and distribution notices, and NAV and performance data.
* **Data Versioning & Integrity:** Specify how data is versioned, corrected, and restated (e.g., immutable, transaction-based designs), and define approaches to entity matching, alias/deduplication, and reconciliation across sources.
* **AI & Automation:** Shape and prioritize agentic and Generative AI capabilities, such as automated document procurement, extraction, classification, and validation. Define accuracy targets, human-in-the-loop review workflows, and evaluation methods.
* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work daily with engineering on architecture trade-offs, feature design, and delivery, ensuring solutions meet client needs and scale with data volume and complexity.
* **Roadmap Creation:** Develop and communicate the product roadmap, setting strategic direction for analytics, research and deal management, managed data services, and accounting capabilities.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Keep stakeholders informed on product updates, roadmap progress, and releases.
* **Client Engagement:** Engage with Clients of Clearwater who maybe a GP, LP to understand their workflows and data needs, and translate them into actionable enhancements.
* **Operational Partnership:** Work with data operations and service teams to measure and reduce manual intervention, turning root causes into product and automation improvements.
* **Success Measurement:** Define KPIs (e.g., data accuracy, coverage, timeliness, straight-through processing rates, adoption, NPS) and use data-driven insights to guide future decisions.
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Act as the go-to expert on private funds and alternative investments, supporting sales, client conversations, and product strategy.
* **Employee Engagement:** Participate in large-scale initiatives that promote employee retention and engagement.
* **Process Improvement:** Teach and guide other teams toward effective processes and best practices.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
* Deep knowledge of Private Markets (Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Assets, Fund of Funds) and the financial services landscape.
* Strong understanding of private fund structures and documents, including LPAs, capital account statements, PCAPs, capital calls and distributions, and NAV and performance reporting.
* Working technical fluency: relational data modeling, SQL, REST APIs, data pipelines, and ETL concepts. You can read schemas and engage credibly in design discussions.
* Familiarity with Generative AI and agentic AI technologies, including document intelligence, extraction, and evaluation, and an understanding of their practical limits in financial data workflows.
* Proven ability to collaborate across sales, product, operations, and technology.
* Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and documentation abilities.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and strong computer skills.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in product management or related roles, including experience owning a technical or data-intensive product.
* 4+ years of professional experience in Investment Management, Operations, or Accounting, with direct exposure to private funds data or workflows.
* Demonstrated experience writing business and technical requirements for a financial technology product or service.
* Experience in data visualization and analytics.
* Demonstrated client engagement experience, with a focus on understanding and addressing client needs.
* Experience presenting to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Alternative Investments, including Private Equity, Limited Partnerships, Private Credit, Mortgage and Bank Loans, or Derivatives.

**Preferred (Nice to Have)**

* Experience with fund administration, LP reporting, or portfolio monitoring platforms.
* Experience with master data management, entity resolution, or data quality frameworks.
* Hands-on experience launching AI-enabled data extraction or document processing products.

title: Product Manager II
job_description:
Responsibilities:

At Principal, we are looking for a dedicated Product Manager II to join our dynamic team in Pune, Maharashtra, India. This is an outstanding opportunity to lead and mentor a team of product managers while influencing the strategic direction of our products.

**Key Responsibilities**

Define and complete product strategy aligned with business and enterprise objectives.

Use customer, market, business, and partner insights to find opportunities and prioritize investments.

  

* Define key business outcomes, product requirements, and success measures for assigned products.
* Lead product discovery activities, including problem identification, experimentation, and validation.

Partner with Build, Engineering, Data, and business teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.

* Own and manage the product roadmap, backlog, prioritization, and delivery of measurable business value.
* Serve as Product Owner for Agile teams and drive effective product delivery through collaboration and dependency management.

Ensure successful product releases and communicate priorities, progress, risks, and outcomes to collaborators.

Establish and monitor product health metrics, benchmarks, and business outcomes to support data-driven decision making.

Build positive relationships with business, technology, operations, and customer-facing collaborators to drive alignment and change readiness.

Lead, mentor, coach, and develop Product Managers while encouraging a strong product culture across collaborating functions.

  

* Perform formal staff reporting responsibilities, including performance management, appraisals, goal setting, career development planning, and continuous feedback.
* Drive staffing, recruitment, onboarding, skill development, succession planning, and backup planning activities.
* Periodically assess the health and maturity of the product management practice and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to organizational initiatives, talent development programs, communities of practice, and enterprise-wide product excellence efforts.

Qualifications:

Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of overall professional experience in Product Management experience in a highly collaborative, Agile environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing products through the full product lifecycle, including strategy, discovery, delivery, assessment, and optimization.
* Experience defining product vision, roadmap, and success metrics.

Strong collaborator management and relationship-building skills.

* Demonstrated ability to lead, influence, negotiate, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams.

Experience applying qualitative and quantitative data to guide decisions and prioritize investments.

* Proven ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum product teams and product ownership responsibilities.
* Exposure to customer-centric product development, experimentation, and outcome-based delivery models.

Additional Information:

Preferred Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong facilitation, collaborator engagement, and prioritization capabilities.

* Experience with Agile delivery frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, Lean Product Management).
* Experience working in legacy as well as cloud-based platforms and modern digital product ecosystems.
* Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, Miro, Azure DevOps, or similar product management tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Data-driven decision-making approach.

* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing without authority.
* Ability to mentor and develop team members while driving organizational outcomes.

Join us at Principal and be part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and a drive for excellence. Let's build the future together!

**Description**

At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.

**Position Description**

**Product Manager – AI & Digital Solutions**

**Role Overview**
=================

At CDW, we make it happen, together. Trust, connection, and commitment are at the heart of how we work together to deliver for our customers. It’s why we’re coworkers, not just employees. Coworkers who genuinely believe in supporting our customers and one another. We collectively forge our path forward with a level of commitment that speaks to who we are and where we’re headed. We’re proud to share our story and Make Amazing Happen at CDW.

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle—from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement—for one or more solutions within CDW’s Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**
===============================

**Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

**Solution Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

**Solution Development & Delivery**

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

**AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

**Working Model**
=================

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Education and/or Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience in one or more of the following:

* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Digital Workplace
* Infrastructure Modernization

Experience with:

* Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

**Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**
=========================================

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

*The information in this position description is intended to convey information about the key responsibilities and requirements of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of the skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the opportunity. Position Descriptions are subject to change.*

**Customer Focus and Quality Management Responsibilities**
==========================================================

Each CDW coworker is responsible for maintaining customer focus and conforms to the CDW quality management system. Specific responsibilities include:

* Periodic reviews of CDW Circle of Service Philosophy and the Quality Policy to understand CDW’s commitment to excellent client service and continual improvement and to conform to these policies and philosophies at all times.
* During your orientation period, review with your supervisor as needed the quality procedures and operating instructions listed at Connect/Departments/Resources/ISO intranet site that apply to your specific assignment(s) within the scope of this job position.
* And after the orientation period to conform to these procedures and instructions, including any reporting (and/or record keeping) responsibilities.
* Report any client problem, or any service outage that may cause potential client problems to your supervisor.
* Communicate improvement ideas that you have regarding CDW service quality or client satisfaction per established means.

**CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization**
=======================================================

* We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.
* Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
Position: Product Manager

Location: Gurgaon

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Experience Required: 4+ years

**Product Manager**
===================

**Reports To:** CTO / CEO

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented Product Manager who can drive product planning, execution, and coordination across teams. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, business acumen, technical understanding, and experience in managing product documentation and Agile product delivery processes. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, development teams, and leadership to define and deliver innovative product solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Prepare and manage PRD (Product Requirement Documents), SRS (Software Requirement Specifications), BRD, and other product documentation.
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and technical requirements from stakeholders.
* Conduct market analysis, competitor analysis, and product feasibility studies.
* Coordinate with Development, QA, Design, and Business teams for successful product delivery.
* Translate business requirements into detailed functional specifications and user stories.
* Work closely with development teams throughout the SDLC lifecycle.
* Manage Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Utilize Jira for project tracking, sprint management, and requirement management.
* Collaborate with UI/UX teams and review wireframes, workflows, and prototypes using Figma.
* Monitor project timelines, risks, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, MIS, and presentations using Excel and other reporting tools.
* Support recruitment analysis, resource planning, and team coordination activities.
* Ensure timely delivery of product features aligned with business goals and customer needs.

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of PRD, SRS, BRD, and product documentation practices.
* Hands-on experience with SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Working knowledge of Jira and Agile project management tools.
* Strong understanding of technology concepts, software development processes, APIs, and system integrations.
* Experience in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, and market research.
* Proficiency in Figma for reviewing product flows, wireframes, and design concepts.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, reporting, and data analysis.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Professional and presentable personality with strong stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* MBA in Management or related field from a recognized institution.
* Experience working in a product-based, SaaS, logistics, fintech, or technology-driven organization.
* Exposure to Product Lifecycle Management and Product Strategy frameworks.
* Ability to manage cross-functional teams and business stakeholders effectively.

**Education**
-------------

MBA in Management or equivalent qualification from a recognized university.

title: Lead Product Manager
job_description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

This job focuses to define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies. Gathering customer experience insights to inform product requirements and analyzing research, market data, and usability studies for data-driven decision-making. Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling. Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Inputs to product strategy with cross-functional stakeholders consistent with the shared vision for the product or enabling platform.
* Implements the architectural roadmap that balances innovative design and technical implementation, while balancing regulatory requirements, time-to-market, meeting customer needs and product profitability.
* Controls for the customer experience and customer needs in product requirements and as an input to decision making.
* Monitors metrics that inform the success of products including usability studies, research and market analysis.
* Manages one or more workstreams to include analytics, customer discovery, market research and competitive analysis to drive data-driven decision-making.
* Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
* Participates in operational mechanisms that drive execution and accountability including Product Reviews, Operating Reviews, and Business Reviews. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
* Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

**Must-Have:**

* **Must have atleast 5+ years of relevant Product Management experience into Payments/Card Acquiring**
* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies.
* Gather customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable product requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead **end-to-end** product development, from discovery and solution design through delivery, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.
* Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling.
* Resolve customer issues, processing challenges, and delivery blockers through hands-on problem solving and root-cause analysis.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, define success metrics, and remain accountable for product delivery and outcomes.

**Subsidiary:**

PayPal

**Travel Percent:**

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

**Our Benefits:**

At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

**Who We Are:**

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

**Belonging at PayPal:**

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

JOB ID: R-256325 LOCATION: India - Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Oct. 13, 2026 CATEGORY: Information Systems

**Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients**

At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission - to serve patients living with serious illnesses - drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

  
  

**What you will d****o**

Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, you will own the day-to-day product lifecycle for Planisware, connecting user needs, business priorities, and technology delivery to improve product adoption, platform performance, and measurable business outcomes.

In this vital role, the Planisware Product Manager will manage the day-to-day product delivery, business administration, sustainment, and continuous improvement of Planisware for Process Development. The role serves as the operational liaison among the state-side Business Product Owner, platform users, business stakeholders, and development teams.

The Planisware Product Manager will convert business priorities into an actionable team backlog; coordinate requirements, configuration, testing, releases, user support, and platform documentation; and coach the delivery team in Agile ways of working.

  
  

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Product management and backlog execution**
--------------------------------------------

* Manage and prioritize the Planisware team backlog in alignment with direction established by the Enterprise Business Platform Owner / Business Owner.
* Support Business Product Owner in translating business needs, user feedback, and processing requirements into clear features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery-ready work.
* Clarify requirements, make day-to-day scope trade-offs within approved priorities, and keep the delivery team focused on the highest-value work.
* Coordinate roadmap execution, release planning, demonstrations, stakeholder feedback loops, and status reporting.
* **Planisware administration and product operations**
  ----------------------------------------------------
* Coordinate platform configuration, testing, defect remediation, change control, release readiness, deployment support, and post-release stabilization with technical teams.
* Monitor support trends, data quality concerns, platform usage, and recurring issues; coordinate corrective and preventive actions.
* Support Planisware capabilities for project timelines, portfolio information, algorithm-driven resource forecasting, reporting, and integrations.

**Agile delivery**
------------------

* Facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and Program Increment or quarterly planning activities.
* Coach the team on Scrum, flow, quality, transparency, self-management, and continuous improvement practices.
* Identify and remove impediments; coordinate dependencies, risks, and delivery issues across business, product, platform, and partner teams.
* Use delivery measures such as sprint goal attainment, cycle time, throughput, spillover, and impediment trends to improve team execution and predictability, not to evaluate individual performance.
* Create an environment of trust, accountability, constructive challenge, and continuous learning.

**Business analysis, user support, and adoption**
-------------------------------------------------

* Liaise between business owners, users, and development teams to streamline product development and maintain shared understanding of priorities and requirements.
* Gather and analyze user feedback and voice-of-customer input; identify support needs and convert validated insights into backlog items or process improvements.
* Coordinate user onboarding, demonstrations, training, communications, job aids, and knowledge articles.
* Support users in understanding Planisware functionality, data standards, reporting outputs, and resource-forecasting processes.
* Partner with adjacent KAI platform teams to align capabilities, technologies, dependencies, and user experiences.

**Governance, quality, and compliance**
---------------------------------------

* Ensure product delivery and administration follow applicable Amgen policies, quality requirements, documentation standards, and established governance processes.
* Maintain traceability from business need through requirement, testing, approval, release, and operational support.
* Escalate material business-priority, risk, scope, or investment decisions to the Enterprise Business Platform Owner / Business Owner.
* Capture lessons learned and embed improvements in delivery and support practices.

**Preferred qualifications**
============================

* Experience administering, configuring, supporting, or managing Planisware or a comparable project and portfolio management platform.
* Experience serving as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Scrum Master, Business Systems Analyst, or platform administrator in an Agile product environment.
* Working knowledge of project portfolio management, integrated timelines, resource forecasting, capacity planning, reporting, and data-quality practices.
* Experience translating business processes into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and release plans.
* Experience facilitating Scrum and Kanban practices and using Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or comparable delivery tools.
* Certified Scrum Master, SAFe Scrum Master, Product Owner / Product Manager, PMI-ACP, or comparable Agile certification.
* Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, release readiness, change management, training, and production support.
* Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, healthcare, manufacturing, R&D, or another regulated environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, conflict-resolution, stakeholder-management, and influencing skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, operate effectively with incomplete information, and maintain delivery focus in a matrixed environment.

**Education & Experience requirements**
=======================================
