job_description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

This job focuses to define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies. This person will own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling. You will collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness. This job is an individual contributor.

**Job Description:**

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Uses data to build insights on product or platform requirements consistent with the shared vision for the product.
* Gathers insights from the customer experience and customer needs to input to product requirements
* Analyzes research, market analysis and usability studies, research and market analysis to support data-driven decision making
* Monitors product profitability measures, including budget.
* Lead sprint planning, daily standups and retrospectives to drive execution. Interfaces with product and technology leadership as needed.
* Partners with content developers, data scientists, product designers and user experience researchers to identify new opportunities.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

**Must Have:**

* Must have atleast 3+years of relevant Product Management experience into Payments/Card Acquiring
* Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for Payments and Payouts Platform including, card acquiring, bank payment processing, and payouts, balancing customer needs, business value, and technical dependencies.
* Gather customer and stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable product requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
* Lead **end-to-end** product development, from discovery and solution design through delivery, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business teams, engineering, architects, operations, risk, and compliance to build scalable capabilities and ensure launch readiness.
* Own payment lifecycle requirements, including processing, settlement, reconciliation, payouts, and exception handling.
* Resolve customer issues, processing challenges, and delivery blockers through hands-on problem solving and root-cause analysis.
* Maintain stakeholder alignment, define success metrics, and remain accountable for product delivery and outcomes.

**Subsidiary:**

PayPal

**Travel Percent:**

0

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

**Our Benefits:**

At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

**Who We Are:**

  

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

**Belonging at PayPal:**

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

We're hiring a proactive, analytical Product Manager to plan, design, and deliver product features for our software products. You'll work closely with design, development, and QA teams to turn ideas into structured, user-friendly features that support our business goals.

* Contribute to product planning and maintain roadmaps and feature priorities
* Design features, including functionality, workflows, user journeys, and dependencies
* Write requirements, functional specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Work with UI/UX designers on wireframes, layouts, and user flows
* Prioritize features, enhancements, and bug fixes by value, impact, feasibility, and effort

* Plan releases and manage timelines and dependencies
* Maintain product documentation and process flows
* Analyze feedback and industry trends to recommend improvements

* 1-3 years in product management, product/business analysis, or a similar IT role
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile, and sprint planning
* Knowledge of user stories, specs, workflows, and UI/UX principles
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
* Experience with Jira, Figma, or Confluence is a plus

**Good to Have :**

* Any ug or pg in technical background or related field with product experience
* A product-oriented mindset and ownership of features from concept to release

job_description:
**Job Summary**

Looking for Product Lead who will own the technology-driven product lifecycle of the personal loan offering from system architecture and platform capability to launch, performance monitoring, and continuous optimisation. This is a tech-centric product role requiring hands-on fluency with the LOS/LMS stack, APIs, and digital lending infrastructure, combined with the ability to align multiple department heads (HODs) around a shared product roadmap for overall business performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the technology roadmap for the personal loan product who drive enhancements to the Loan Origination System (LOS), Loan Management System (LMS), CRM, and customer-facing digital journeys (app/web).
* Partner with the Technology/IT/Engineering HOD to define system architecture, API integrations (credit bureaus, KYC/Aadhaar e-sign, payment gateways, UPI AutoPay/NACH), and platform scalability requirements.
* Translate business and credit requirements into detailed functional/technical specifications (BRDs/PRDs/user stories) for developers and QA teams and own UAT sign-off before releases. Drive automation and digitisation of the loan journey from onboarding, KYC, credit decisioning, e-sign, disbursal, and repayment to reduce manual intervention and improve TAT.
* Collaborate with the Credit & Risk HOD to translate underwriting policy and scoring logic into system rules and automated decision engines.
* Work with the Compliance & Legal HOD to ensure all product workflows, data handling, and system processes meet RBI/NBFC regulatory and data-security requirements.
* Align with the Sales & Business HOD on product positioning, ticket-size/tenure structures, and channel-specific journey requirements (DSA, digital, in-house).
* Partner with the Marketing HOD on data requirements for campaign targeting, lead scoring, and conversion-funnel tracking.
* Own product analytics and reporting infrastructure from set up dashboards (Power BI/SQL) to track approval rate, disbursement TAT, drop-off points, portfolio yield, and system uptime.
* Benchmark competitor personal loan platforms (fintechs, NBFCs, banks) on technology and journey experience and recommend product/tech differentiation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Strong, hands-on understanding of digital lending technology architecture — LOS/LMS platforms, API integrations, credit bureau pulls, e-KYC/e-sign, payment/NACH systems.
* Ability to write and review BRDs/PRDs, work with Agile/Scrum delivery teams, and manage release cycles alongside Engineering.
* Solid grasp of personal loan/unsecured lending products, credit underwriting logic, and NBFC operations.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with SQL/Power BI/Excel to interpret system and portfolio data for product decisions.
* Working knowledge of RBI regulatory guidelines and data-security/IT-compliance requirements applicable to NBFC digital lending.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering/technology/computer science preferred;

**Working Hours and Days Full Time**

* Monday to Saturday (Sat – WFH)
* 10:00 A.M. – 6:30 P.M

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Product Manager - Onboarding
job_description:
Overview:

***Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity***

With 4,300 employees and over 400,000 retail and institutional clients from more than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune-100, Nasdaq-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.

At StoneX, we offer you the opportunity to be part of an institutional-grade financial services network that connects companies, organizations, and investors to the global markets ecosystem. As a team member, you'll benefit from our unique blend of digital platforms, comprehensive clearing and execution services, personalized high-touch support, and deep industry expertise. Elevate your career with us and make a significant impact in the world of global finance.

Immerse yourself in the best-in-class institutional-grade technology, working alongside industry experts and gaining exposure to various asset classes, such as equities, options, fixed income securities, and advanced trading, research, and management technology.

Responsibilities:

**Position Purpose:**

StoneX is modernising client onboarding and setup across the firm. This multi-year programme will replace fragmented and duplicated processes with a controlled, scalable capability spanning due diligence and KYC/AML through account creation, entitlements, credit and risk setup, reference data and trading readiness.

The Onboarding Product Management team bridges the technical and business worlds, working closely with Engineering, Business Analysis, Compliance/AML and other business functions to deliver this capability. As an Associate Product Manager, you will lead analysis within defined onboarding workstreams, work with stakeholders to identify improvement opportunities, and help translate agreed changes into product and delivery outcomes. This may include exploring how automation and AI could streamline onboarding processes.

This is a hands-on opportunity to learn product management, work with stakeholders across regions and business lines, and influence how the onboarding experience is delivered.

**Primary duties will include:**

* Leading the analysis of current-state onboarding processes within assigned workstreams, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, control and client experience.
* Engaging stakeholders across regions and business lines to gather input, validate findings and support recommendations.
* Collecting and analysing feedback, product analytics and market insights to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation.
* Working with large data sets to identify volumes, bottlenecks and trends across onboarding processes.
* Translating product ideas into clear requirements and deliverables.
* Partnering with senior Product Managers to shape onboarding product strategy and roadmap.

We’re looking for a customer-focused Product Manager II to join us on this mission.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Use data, customer insights and partnership across PM, engineering, data science, user research and design disciplines to develop and deliver product improvements with hypothesis for growth, discovery and satisfaction in the Copilot app (Windows/Mac).
* Develop deep understanding of the business, our customers, and the competitive landscape through market and customer research.
* Partner across engineering teams, design, marketing, and business execute on the roadmap — focus on rapid iteration, learning and improvement.
* Define clear metrics and projected impact for all investments using a product and customer led growth approach.
* Foster an environment that encourages diversity of thought and an inclusive team culture in a geographically distributed and hybrid work environment.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of Product/Program Management experience on end-user facing products.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, related field or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience and expertise with data to address business needs, apply analytical and inferential techniques to answer questions and produce product recommendations in partnership across disciplines preferred.
* Proven ability to develop product roadmaps to deliver customer and business value across products and services.
* Experience working with data or AI-powered products to deliver greater user value.
* Track record of successful design, delivery, and iteration on complex projects with a diverse set of stakeholders.
* Experience with customer-centric and data-driven insights creation, strategy definition, and experimentation.
* Customer empathy with experience in user-centered design; demonstrated success.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Product Manager – BOSCO-Bengaluru
job_description:
**Job Description: Product Manager – BOSCO-Bengaluru**

Company: Bandhoo

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka.

Job Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–3 years

**About Bandhoo**

Bandhoo is a technology-driven company building SaaS solutions for construction project execution and workforce management.

**About BOSCO**

BOSCO is a workforce management platform that supports attendance, productivity tracking, workforce compliance, contractor payroll, and workforce marketplace operations.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager – BOSCO to take ownership of BOSCO. You will work with engineering, design, and business teams to understand user needs, define product requirements, and deliver useful product improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own the BOSCO product roadmap and priorities in collaboration with the CTO and leadership team.

· Manage the product lifecycle from user discovery and requirements gathering to prioritisation, development, release, and continuous improvement.

· Improve marketplace matching, fulfilment, user engagement, and messaging efficiency.

· Improve workflows for attendance, productivity tracking, workforce compliance, and contractor payroll.

· Speak with workers, contractors, field supervisors, HR teams, and customers to understand problems and improve product usability.

· Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria; coordinate with engineering and design teams during development.

· Support sprint planning, review product builds, prioritise bugs, and help deliver releases on time.

· Track product adoption, engagement, retention, matching, and fulfilment metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

· Collaborate with business and operations teams to align product improvements with customer and business needs.

**Requirements**

· 1–3 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, HRTech, workforce management, marketplaces, or operations-focused technology.

· Ability to translate user and business needs into clear product requirements.

· Understanding of agile product development and the software development lifecycle.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Experience with workforce management, contractor management, payroll, or marketplace products.

· Familiarity with mobile apps for field workers or offline environments.

· Experience with product analytics tools such as Mixpanel, PostHog, or Amplitude.

· A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

**What We’re Looking For**

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Clear communication and collaboration skills.

· A proactive approach, ownership mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Powered by an outstanding end-to-end e-commerce and logistics network and a fanatical culture of customer centricity, Coupang has broken tradeoffs around speed, selection, and price. Today, we provide exceedingly fast shipping speeds on millions of items including fresh groceries, delivered within hours nationwide, 365 days a year. We are doing this for millions of consumers in Korea, one of the world's largest and fastest growing e-commerce markets. Korea is currently the 5th largest e-commerce market in the world.  
Finance Platform and Engineering (FPE) Product team owns the procure-to-cash, order- to-cash and sellers' settlement experience across various business verticals at Coupang.  
Our team collaborates with various Engineering, Finance, Seller Experience and Support teams to ensure that all transactions produced by the various platforms at Coupang with financial impact are accurately accounted for to ensure that our suppliers and sellers are paid precisely and on-time.  
  
**Job Description:**

  

We are seeking a highly motivated, experienced, and dynamic Senior Product Manager to own and drive the product strategy for how sellers interact with and consume their settlement data through the seller portal. This role focuses on ensuring that sellers have easy, intuitive, and transparent access to critical financial data, empowering them to understand and manage their payments effectively.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for how to evolve the seller settlement experience

* Drive end-to-end product development, from ideation and requirements gathering to release and continuous improvement, working closely with engineering, design, data, and finance teams

* Regularly engage with external customers and internal partner teams to gather

product requirements and feedback through discussions, presentations, and

preview programs

* Define and prioritize product features, user stories, and acceptance criteria,

maintaining a well-groomed backlog and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality

releases

* Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and drive continuous improvement, adjusting the roadmap and strategy as

needed

* Communicate product status, progress and insights to stakeholders and

leadership, fostering a culture of transparency, collaboration, and data-driven

decision making

* Champion a customer-centric approach to product development, acting as an

advocate for user needs and fostering a culture of empathy and innovation

  

Basic Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance or

equivalent experience.

* 8+ years of product/program management, solutions architecture, or engineering experience, with a track record of delivering complex, large-scale technical

products in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset and

commitment to evidence-based decision making.

* Demonstrates the ability to quickly grasp new concepts, technologies, and

industry trends, adapting to a constantly evolving business landscape and staying ahead of the curve.

* Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

* Proven ability to balance competing priorities, manage multiple projects

simultaneously, and deliver results under varying constraints.

* Consistently works backwards from customers' needs, ensuring that productdecisions are driven by a thorough understanding of user requirements, pain

points and jobs to be done.

Preferred Qualifications

* MBA or equivalent degree is a strong plus.

* Knowledge of accounting principles, financial systems, and industry best practices, with a strong understanding of the unique challenges faced by eCommerce businesses.

* Experience building and launching Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) or Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).

title: Global Product Manager - Respiratory Accessories
job_description:
### **Job Title**

Global Product Manager - Respiratory Accessories

### **Job Description**

As a **Global Product Manager(GPM)- Respiratory Accessories,** you will work on **sustaining and optimizing the existing respiratory accessories portfolio** , including roadmap prioritization, portfolio simplification, margin, and lifecycle performance

**Your role:**

  

**Product roadmap and go-to-market understanding**

* Owns the **execution of the claims roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional teams** to prioritize validated claims based on market trends and regulatory requirements, while continuously optimizing the strategy through analysis of competitor activity, customer insights, and compliance needs.
* **Maintains relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) to align their insights and advocacy** **with product strategy** , driving engagement through advisory boards and educational initiatives to enhance product credibility, market influence, and thought leadership while measuring impact on market adoption and positioning.
* Collaborates extensively with regional cross-functional teams to guide channel strategies and develop robust go-to-market plans that drive product adoption and revenue growth

Job Description: Edge Management Platform (EMP)

**Job Title:** Edge Management Platform (EMP)  
**Job Function:** Technical Platforms & Infrastructure mandatory  
**Experience:** Relevant experience in technical product management  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Location:** Bangalore

**Immediate joiners within 30 days preferred.**

1. Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong and customer-focused **Product Manager for an Edge Management Platform (EMP)** to drive the product strategy, roadmap, and evolution of a platform that simplifies application deployment and management across distributed infrastructure environments.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with technical platforms such as cloud infrastructure, virtualisation, hypervisors, Kubernetes, container platforms, or infrastructure management solutions.

Prior experience in Edge Computing is not mandatory. However, candidates must demonstrate strong technical platform understanding, sound product management capabilities, and the ability to translate complex infrastructure challenges into simple, scalable, and user-friendly product experiences.

The role requires a product owner who can make independent prioritisation decisions, understand customer needs, collaborate closely with engineering teams, and deliver measurable business and technical outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

* **Product Strategy & Roadmap:** Define and maintain the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities in alignment with customer needs and business objectives.
* **Technical Platform Ownership:** Develop a strong understanding of the underlying infrastructure, including cloud platforms, hypervisors, Kubernetes, virtualisation, and application deployment technologies.
* **Customer Experience:** Identify opportunities to simplify application deployment, infrastructure management, monitoring, and operational workflows for application teams.
* **Self-Service & Automation:** Drive product capabilities such as self-service provisioning, API-based integrations, automated deployments, resource management, and lifecycle operations.
* **Product Prioritisation:** Evaluate competing requirements and balance new features against reliability, scalability, security, automation, and technical debt.
* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work closely with engineering, architecture, design, and operations teams to define requirements, evaluate dependencies, and guide implementation.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Gather and prioritise input from customers, engineering teams, business stakeholders, and other product teams.
* **Platform Reliability:** Ensure product decisions support operational visibility, failure handling, resilience, and consistent management across distributed environments.
* **Product Delivery & Outcomes:** Define success metrics, monitor adoption and performance, and use customer feedback and measurable results to improve the platform continuously.

3. Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Skills

* 9+ years of experience
* Cloud platforms and infrastructure management.
* Virtualisation technologies and hypervisors.
* Kubernetes, containers, and orchestration platforms.
* Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) or Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS).
* Application deployment, monitoring, provisioning, and lifecycle management.
* Distributed systems, APIs, and automation frameworks.
* Understanding of how application platforms interact with underlying infrastructure.
* Ability to explain technical concepts and platform capabilities in simple, business-oriented language.

Product Management Skills

* Demonstrated ownership of product strategy, roadmap, prioritisation, and product decisions.
* Experience translating user problems into product features, requirements, and capabilities.
* Ability to balance customer requests, engineering constraints, technical improvements, and business priorities.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience defining product success metrics and evaluating outcomes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will:

* Have worked as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, Platform Product Manager, or in a comparable product ownership role.
* Have hands-on exposure to infrastructure-related products or technically complex platforms.
* Demonstrate a clear understanding of platform users, their challenges, and the value delivered by the product.
* Show evidence of making product decisions rather than solely coordinating engineering delivery, managing sprints, or tracking project milestones.
* Be comfortable applying experience from cloud, Kubernetes, virtualisation, or infrastructure platforms to new problem spaces, including Edge Management.

**Note:** Direct Edge Computing experience is an advantage, not a mandatory requirement.

Pay: Up to ₹4,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

job_description:
HackerRank helps companies like NVIDIA, Amazon, and Microsoft hire and upskill the next generation of developers based on skills, not pedigree. Our platform is trusted by over 2,500 of the world's most innovative companies to build strong engineering teams ready for what's next.  
  
Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

HackerRank Interviews is a live technical interviewing platform designed to evaluate how candidates solve realistic engineering problems, not just whether they can pass an algorithm test. Candidates and interviewers collaborate in a shared workspace using coding tools, production-style repositories, and Plan-Build-Review tasks. The platform also supports observable AI-assisted development, letting teams assess how candidates prompt, review, and apply AI-generated work, with observation tools and post-interview reports giving hiring teams clearer, structured evidence for decisions.  
In this role, you'll help lead the Interviews product - an AI-native, pair-programming interview experience that gives interviewers the ability to collaborate with candidates on real-world problems and code repos. You'll shape how the platform evolves across richer ADE experiences (harnesses like Claude Code and Codex CLI), Chakra Assist for evaluation, richer session observation (screen sharing, A/V), and reporting across in-product, exports, APIs and MCP. You'll work closely with engineers as collaborators and as the product's core customer and user base including senior engineering leadership as stakeholders who care deeply about this space.

#### **What you will do**

* Own the roadmap for how HackerRank Interviews evaluates AI-assisted development including richer ADE harnesses, Chakra Assist, and session observation capabilities.
* Define how the platform captures and surfaces signals on how candidates prompt, review and apply AI-generated work, so interviewers get clearer, structured evidence.
* Drive the reporting and integration strategy across in-product reporting, exports, APIs and MCP.
* Engage directly with engineering customers and users including senior engineering leadership as the primary audience for this product, translating their needs into roadmap decisions.
* Represent the product in high-visibility, customer-facing moments with composure, including when executives engage directly and unexpectedly.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Design to ship production-quality, AI-native interview experiences.
* Embrace AI - in how we operate, as well as in the product.

#### **Who you are**

* Overall 7+ years of total professional experience including at least 1 year of hands-on Software Engineering.
* 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably building B2B SaaS, enterprise products and/or tech services and/or platforms, and you are currently working as a PM today.
* Comfortable being the technical/product voice in a room full of engineers, including stakeholders like senior engineering leadership
* Able to stay composed and sound under sudden high-visibility pressure for example, a CTO persona dropping into a live customer channel.
* A strategic thinker who can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and balance short-term progress with long-term success.
* Deeply passionate about AI using it as a reflex across your own workflows, not just in the product you build.
* Ability to deep dive into ambitious problem statements and create customer value.
* Proven track record of successfully launching and growing new products and/or significant features.
* Ability to work in a fast paced cross team, cross geo environment and to deliver on a common vision.
* Ability to work with engineers, designers and analysts and be comfortable presenting to non-technical/business stakeholders and customers.

#### **Even better if you have**

* Hands-on fluency with agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Copilot Workspace, or similar) deep enough to reason about what a good AI-assisted engineering actually looks like.
* Experience designing or owning a GTM motion where the buyer and user were engineers or engineering leadership, rather than a traditional non-technical economic buyer.
* Experience operating in a lean, founder-style team with no dedicated marketing support i.e., you've personally built your own sales decks, messaging and customer-facing materials before, not just briefed a marketing team.
* Background in HR tech, talent assessment, or technical hiring.
* Experience building reporting/analytics or API-level integrations (e.g. MCP, data exports) for a technical audience.

#### **You will thrive in this role if you**

* **You are a builder at heart.** You enjoy creating something from scratch, transforming ideas into tangible, high-impact products.
* **Ambiguity excites you**. You're comfortable working in undefined spaces, carving out clarity where little exists, and defining a clear vision and strategy.
* **You take a customer-first approach.** You excel at identifying unmet customer needs and turning those insights into innovative product solutions.
* **You are a strategic thinker.** You can evaluate complex challenges, prioritise effectively, and make decisions that balance short-term progress with long-term success.
* **You thrive in fast-paced environments.** You're energised by working on high-impact initiatives where priorities can shift as you gain new insights.
* **You have a bias for action.** You're not afraid to experiment, iterate, and learn quickly in pursuit of delivering exceptional outcomes.
* **You are deeply passionate about AI.** You're in the weeds and trying out AI tools constantly and are at a point where you are using AI as a reflex to try and automate several workflows in your life and 10x yourself.

**Want to learn more about HackerRank?** Check out HackerRank.com to explore our products, solutions and resources, and dive into our story and mission here.

HackerRank is a proud equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer. We provide equal opportunity to everyone for employment based on individual performance and qualification. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Linkedin | X | Blog | Instagram | Life@HackerRank

*Notice to prospective HackerRank job applicants:*

* *Our Recruiters use @hackerrank.com email addresses.*
* *We never ask for payment or credit check information to apply, interview, or work here.*

title: AA Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.

 **Job Description**

**Role Summary:**

* Lead brand and product marketing activities for Allergan Aesthetics India to drive growth, customer engagement, and business performance.
* Own the end-to-end brand strategy across the product life cycle, including new product launches, campaign development, performance tracking, and optimization.
* Work effectively in a matrix organization, partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver business objectives in alignment with AbbVie values.

**Purpose of the Role**

The Brand / Product Manager is responsible for driving the strategic and operational management of an assigned brand or product portfolio within Allergan Aesthetics India. This role leads brand growth through robust marketing strategy, customer insight, data-driven decision-making, and effective cross-functional execution. The position owns key elements of the product life cycle, including launch planning, campaign execution, performance tracking, and lifecycle optimization, while operating in alignment with AbbVie values, business priorities, and compliance expectations.

This is a highly visible, leadership-oriented role requiring strong influence across a matrix organization, with accountability for delivering results through collaboration, insight, and disciplined execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute integrated brand plans and marketing strategies aligned to business objectives, market dynamics, and portfolio priorities.
* Lead product life cycle management across launch, growth, maturity, and optimization phases.
* Own new product launch planning and execution, including positioning, messaging, segmentation, readiness, rollout, and post-launch tracking.
* Design and implement multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, field, and customer-facing initiatives.
* Define, track, and report key performance indicators to measure campaign effectiveness, brand performance, and return on investment.
* Conduct primary and secondary market research to generate actionable insights on customers, consumers, competitors, and market trends.
* Map customer and consumer journeys to identify opportunities to improve engagement and impact at each touchpoint.
* Prepare high-quality business reviews, brand reviews, leadership updates, and strategic presentations.
* Build and maintain analytical dashboards, trackers, and reports using advanced Excel and PowerPoint capabilities.
* Use data analytics to inform business decisions, identify growth opportunities, and optimize marketing investments.
* Support business case preparation, commercial planning, forecasting, and budget tracking for assigned brand activities.
* Coordinate digital and social media campaign planning, rollout, and performance measurement in partnership with internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively with Medical, Sales, Commercial Excellence, Market Access, Regulatory, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Supply Chain, and other relevant teams.
* Manage agencies, vendors, and partners to ensure delivery of high-quality outputs on time and within budget.
* Ensure all materials, programs, and communications comply with AbbVie policies, ethical standards, and applicable local regulations.
* Monitor market, customer, and competitor developments to identify risks, opportunities, and strategic actions.
* Contribute to franchise and portfolio-level planning with insights grounded in customer needs and market evidence.
* Demonstrate strong stakeholder management and influence across a complex matrix environment.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Marketing, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Relevant experience in brand management, product management, or marketing in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, aesthetics, medical devices, or a similarly regulated environment.
* Proven experience in product life cycle management and new product launches.

**Role:** Product Manager – Product Strategy & Growth

**Location:** Bangalore

**Full/ Part-time:** Full time

**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

**About the role:** This role defines product strategy and drives business growth by translating market and stakeholder needs into actionable priorities. The Product Manager identifies growth opportunities through adoption analysis, assesses product potential, and develops commercial strategies, including pricing and offering tiers. The role oversees the product lifecycle—from roadmap prioritization and development tracking to launch and post-launch feedback—while connecting stakeholders, engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success. It also monitors competitors and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**1. Product Strategy & Business Case**

* Define the product vision, strategy, and value proposition aligned to business objectives.
* Build business cases covering market opportunity, customer need, competitive positioning, revenue potential, investment, and ROI.
* Develop financial models, pricing scenarios, and commercialization strategies.
* Present investment recommendations to leadership; track market trends and emerging technology to drive innovation.

**2. Pricing & Commercial Strategy**

* Define pricing, packaging, and monetization models; benchmark against competitive pricing.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and business leaders to optimize commercial models.
* Monitor profitability, ARR, margin, adoption, and customer lifetime value, and recommend pricing adjustments.

**3. Roadmap & Prioritization**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap; translate opportunities into initiatives, epics, and releases.
* Facilitate prioritization workshops balancing customer need, business value, technical feasibility, and strategy.
* Apply prioritization frameworks based on ROI, customer impact, and market demand.
* Drive alignment across engineering, UX, customer success, sales, and executive stakeholders.

**4. Requirements Management**

* Gather, analyze, and document business and customer requirements.
* Author PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional/non-functional specifications.
* Work with UX and Engineering to refine solutions and validate technical feasibility.
* Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and product reviews.

**5. Launch & Adoption**

* Define launch, enablement, and adoption strategies; execute go-to-market plans with Marketing and Sales.
* Drive onboarding, customer training, and customer success initiatives.
* Track adoption, usage, engagement, retention, and revenue performance.
* Identify adoption barriers, act on post-release feedback, and improve value realization.

**6. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership**

* Act as the primary point of contact for product decisions across internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate consensus and decision-making across diverse groups.
* Report roadmap progress, product performance, risks, and opportunities; influence strategy with data-driven recommendations.

**7. Performance & Analytics**

* Define and track product KPIs and success metrics.
* Measure adoption, retention, revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and ROI.
* Maintain executive dashboards and lead periodic product performance reviews.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical, or Computer Science; or an MBA with specialization in Product Management.
* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or Product Strategy roles.
* Demonstrated experience across business case development, pricing and commercialization, roadmap management, requirements documentation, and go-to-market execution.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum product development methodologies.
* Strong analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving capability.
* Experience with SaaS, digital, or platform products and subscription-based business models.
* Exposure to product analytics tooling and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience managing products across multiple markets, segments, or channel partners.

**Benefits**

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and well‑being programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.

**Equal Treatment and Non-Discrimination**

Carrier is committed to equal treatment and non-discrimination principles. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or disability, or any other applicable protected class.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com.We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws.

We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Product Management Executive to support product planning, data analysis, documentation, and coordination with design and development teams. The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of product functionality, strong Excel skills, and a proactive approach to managing tasks and improving product performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Management: Understand product features, functionality, workflows, and requirements, and support day-to-day product activities.
* Data Analysis: Analyze product-related data, prepare reports, and identify insights to support decision-making.
* Excel & Reporting: Use MS Excel or Google Sheets for data tracking, analysis, and reporting.
* Product Documentation: Maintain product requirements, feature lists, workflows, and related documentation.
* Team Coordination: Work with designers, developers, and internal teams to communicate requirements and track progress.
* Product Improvement: Identify issues, analyze gaps, and suggest improvements to product functionality and user experience.
* Task Management: Track deliverables, monitor timelines, and ensure assigned tasks are completed efficiently.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 6 months to 1 year of relevant experience in product management, product operations, business analysis, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets.
* Basic understanding of product management and product development processes.
* Basic knowledge of Figma, UI/UX, or software development concepts.
* Good communication, coordination, and documentation skills.
* Responsible, organized, and capable of taking ownership of assigned tasks.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**Job Description**

To support the development of our Lens data analytics platform, we are looking for a dynamic Senior Product Manager to be an integral part of our Commodities Product team covering Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals and Metals & Mining.

*Knowledge & experience*

* Experienced Product Manager, or Analyst looking to expand their role into the Product Management space
* Experience with the product development cycle including agile software development (Scrum/Kanban), design process, and instrumenting analytics.
* Basic industry knowledge and strong interest on one or multiple sectors covered in our portfolio (Gas & LNG, Oils & Chemicals, Metals & Mining), understanding of the major players, market conditions, and industry standards. Intellectual curiosity for industry is a must.
* Experience working on data migrations projects, and using AI in product development is a strong plus.
* Good oral and written communication skills
* Key tools that we use are JIRA, Productboard and Amplitude. Our tech stack is mainly on AWS and Snowflake.

*Impact on the team*

* Act as the day-to-day point person for the cross-functional team, providing a seamless bridge between Research Analysts, Data teams, UX, and Engineering to identify solutions that work within a set of defined constraints and align to the broader business strategy and achieve customer-focused results.
* Align understanding by defining user requirements with clear acceptance criteria across multiple features
* Assist in documentation and testing of given solutions to ensure fit for customers
* Collaborate with the Senior Product Manager to help communicate product value and priorities to internal teams, including sales and marketing
Foster healthy culture, support and collaboration for a distributed team  

*Stakeholder & client relationships*

* Translate requirements from customers and defining the product functionality according to wider customer needs
* Inform senior stakeholders on progress and raise risks to the appropriate level
* Engage frequently with users to gather feedback from relevant customers and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Marketing and Sales to enable go-to-market effort

**Equal Opportunities**

We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

author: Hiring Manager
title: Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Optum Technology Consumer Engineering organization is transforming how millions of people experience healthcare. As part of Optum's Chief Digital Office (CDO), we deliver digital first, personalized experiences that help consumers find, access, and navigate care, leveraging modern cloud platforms, data, AI, and conversational technologies at national scale.

Serving UnitedHealth Group's digital technology needs, the CDO organization supports experiences used by more than 30 million UnitedHealthcare members. Our mission is to radically improve how consumers and providers engage with the healthcare system by delivering intuitive, personalized, and trustworthy digital experiences across the healthcare journey.

Technical Product Managers within the CDO own the definition and delivery of complex, cross team digital and agentic experiences that are critical to Optum's consumer strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with business product managers, UX designers, engineers, architects, and fellow technical product managers to translate business priorities and user insights into well defined, outcome driven member experiences.

As a Technical Product Manager, you will translate strategy and lead execution across multiple teams and systems, operating with a high degree of autonomy. You will also lead AI accelerated product development and responsibly integrate AI into consumer experiences to improve speed, quality, and member outcomes.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Understand needs and define opportunities
  + Partner with business product and domain stakeholders to understand business objectives, user needs, and digital experience trends
  + Translate insights into clearly articulated, outcome driven opportunities that align with business priorities and consumer value
* Develop and support product roadmaps
  + Collaborate with business product counterparts to articulate strategy, prioritize opportunities, and define multi quarter roadmaps
  + Assess feasibility, dependencies, and costs to ensure roadmaps are executable and aligned with investment guardrails
* Define executable experiences and enhancements
  + Partner with UX, engineering, and architecture leaders to elaborate opportunities into clearly defined experiences, features, and enhancements
  + Ensure requirements and success metrics are unambiguous, testable, and aligned to intended member outcomes
* Technical fluency and solution partnership
  + Partner closely with engineering and architecture leaders to understand end to end system flows, technical constraints, and solution options
  + Evaluate technical alternatives, decompose complex problems into executable increments, and define requirements for dependent teams and systems
* Drive successful execution
  + Lead execution across multiple teams and platforms, sequencing work across dependencies and influencing backlog prioritization and trade off decisions
  + Proactively identify, manage, and resolve cross team risks, issues, and dependencies; escalate effectively when needed
  + Ensure delivery of high quality outcomes while managing costs within allocated budgets
* Champion AI accelerated product development and AI infused experiences
  + Champion the effective use of AI tools across product discovery, definition, delivery, and operations to improve speed and quality
  + Identify and elaborate opportunities to responsibly incorporate AI into member experiences, with clear measurement, monitoring, and feedback loops
* Operational excellence
  + Deeply understand how experiences perform in production, including usage, member sentiment, quality metrics, and operational issues
  + Use data and feedback to identify improvement opportunities and inform roadmap and prioritization decisions
* Executive ready communication
  + Communicate progress, trade offs, risks, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders
  + Articulate value through concise narratives, artifacts, and data backed insights tailored to both technical and non technical audiences
* Leadership and mentorship
  + Provide mentorship and informal leadership to other technical product managers
  + Raise the bar for product definition, execution rigor, and cross functional collaboration within the TPM community
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience
* 7+ years of experience in technical or software product management, or closely related roles
* Demonstrated experience delivering complex, technology enabled digital products using modern product discovery and delivery practices
* Demonstrated solid ability to partner with and influence business, UX, engineering, architecture, and data teams
* Proven ability to operate effectively amid ambiguity, complexity, and cross portfolio dependencies
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication skills with both technical and non technical stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in the healthcare industry
* Experience delivering consumer facing web and mobile digital experiences at scale
* Experience integrating AI responsibly into customer facing digital products with measurable outcomes
* Experience using AI tools to improve product discovery, definition, delivery, and/or operational maturity
* Demonstrated solid presentation and storytelling skills, with experience influencing senior leaders

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes , an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

**About the role**
------------------

The Product Manager leads the squad, managing the vision, backlog, and day-to-day priorities. They are responsible for achieving key business outcomes by integrating stakeholder perspectives to meet Tribe goals. They define and prioritize requirements in the squad's backlog and approve completed items.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

1. Delivers the product vision, strategy, and roadmap to meet customer and commercial needs, driving alignment with Tribe goals.
  
2. Ensures congruence with strategy, aligning squad objectives with BT Group’s transformation goals.
  
3. Drives cross-functional teams towards Tribe objectives, leveraging a customer-first mindset and technical product expertise.
  
4. Supports the squad backlog, prioritizing features based on business value and execution impact using data-driven insights.
  
5. Leads annual planning and quarterly prioritization, taking accountability for budgeting and resource allocation.
  
6. Facilitates the mitigation of risks and blockers, ensuring transparency and driving resolution across teams and stakeholders.
  
7. Supports the continuous improvement of ways of working, acting as a champion for transformation and operational excellence.
  
8. Mentors and develops squad members, nurturing leadership growth and future capabilities within the team.
  
9. Adapts product strategy based on evolving market trends, customer feedback, and competitive landscape.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

**Our Package**
---------------

Join us at a pivotal moment for BT Business. We are executing a multi-year transformation to restore growth, modernise at scale and unlock new markets beyond connectivity. Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention.
  
  
We are fundamentally reshaping the business – simplifying our portfolio, digitising our customer experience and building market-leading capability across cyber, AI and managed services, all powered by the UK’s leading fixed and mobile networks. This is a shift from a legacy connectivity provider to a modern, solutions-led, AI-first business that can truly differentiate in a competitive and fast-moving market.
  
  
With execution momentum building and a clear path to growth, the opportunity now is to scale what works, accelerate performance and fully realise our potential. This is about delivering against ambitious financial outcomes while transforming how we operate – creating a business that is simpler, faster, more innovative and easier to do business with.
  
  
If you want to be part of the team shaping the turnaround of a multi-billion-pound business – and building a stronger, more competitive BT for the future – this is your moment.

job_description:
**About Us:**

**Luna is a health intelligence company**. Our wearables and LifeOS platform build a working model of your body, and turn it into a plan for your day. Luna Ring and Luna Band read continuous biomarker signals, from sleep and recovery to heart rate variability, circadian phase and menstrual cycle. LifeOS combines that with your nutrition, supplements, blood panels and daily context to build a plan for your day: what to do, and when to do it. Luna ships to 150+ countries, and our work has been recognised by the global tech press and international design and innovation awards.

We're grounded in science, driven by data, and occasionally powered by questionable coffee choices. But above all, we’re united by a shared mission: to reimagine how wearable tech can help people know themselves better and push their potential further.

**Your Role:**

We’re looking for a Product Manager – App to lead our health-tech experience and build our LifeOS.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, CX, and our beta community to deliver features that are elegant, evidence-based, and habit-forming.

**Responsibilities:**

● Own and evolve the entire Luna App roadmap, including onboarding, dashboard design,

insights, and user journeys.

● Lead product discovery and delivery for high-impact features like Energy OS, Circadian Rhythm,

Sleep Recovery and AI-based health layer.

● Have a strong understanding towards building algorithms

● Drive measurable improvements in app retention, App Store rating, feature adoption, and

session engagement.

● Translate complex physiological and behavioral science into simple, engaging app flows.

● Use data (Amplitude / Firebase / Mixpanel) to learn user behaviour

● Interact on and close the loop on feedback from beta groups and other digital communities.

**Requirements:**

*Must-Have:*

● 5+ years of product experience, with at least 2+ years leading a consumer mobile app

● Bachelors/M.S/Phd in Data Science, ML, Statistics from a Tier 1 college

● Personal interest in quantified self, training, mindfulness, sleep science, or longevity

● Experience in deep-healthtech, wellness, wearables, or fitness—with user empathy and domain

fluency.

● Exposure to AI productization, health APIs

● Strong data, algorithms understanding is critical to this role.

● Demonstrated ability to improve app retention, adoption, or ratings through thoughtful product

changes.

● Deep familiarity with mobile UX, behavioral design, and habit loop creation.

● Comfort with using data tools (Amplitude, Firebase, etc.) and setting clear success metrics.

● High clarity of thought; can operate independently, structure ambiguity, and move

cross-functional teams.

● A strong POV on what makes a truly great app experience in the wellness space.

**What You’ll Get:**

● A front-row seat to the future of wearable intelligence

● Massive ownership and impact on a fast-growing global product

● Chance to build the world’s most advanced LifeOS.

● Competitive compensation + ESOPs

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your Current CTC?
* What is the Notice Period in your current Company?

Work Location: In person

job_description:
### **Why join Stryker?**

Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award-winning culture.  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

### **Job description**

We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  
We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.

Join Stryker’s enterprise technology team and play a key role in delivering and maintaining Workday integration solutions that connect critical business systems. This position focuses on leading integration development, testing, release management, and vendor coordination while ensuring scalable, high-quality solutions that support global business operations.

**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the development and delivery of Workday integration solutions connecting Workday with internal and third-party systems.
* Manage multiple integration programs, tracking milestones, deliverables, risks, and overall development progress.
* Oversee integration testing activities, including code reviews, functional validation, and defect resolution.
* Configure and maintain Workday integrations using Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), APIs, XML, XSLT, and Workday Prism.
* Create and support custom reports, calculated fields, and integration frameworks to meet business requirements.
* Manage change requests and release processes, ensuring timely deployment and compliance with quality standards.
* Coordinate and review the work of external vendors and third-party development partners throughout the development lifecycle.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to resource planning, workload management, and global team initiatives.
* What You Will Need

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 12 years of experience in software development, systems integration, or enterprise application development.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in Workday integration development.
* Experience with Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Workday Prism, XML, XSLT, and API integrations.
* Experience creating custom reports, calculated fields, and Workday integrations.
* Experience with Workday security configuration and business process configuration.
* Experience troubleshooting and resolving Workday technical and integration issues.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience leading enterprise integration programs involving multiple stakeholders and vendors.
* Experience working in Agile software development and release management environments.
* Additional Information
* Work arrangement: Hybrid or onsite based on business needs and location requirements.
* May collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.
* Limited travel may be required based on project and business needs.
* Relocation support is subject to business requirements and local policy.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Principal Product Manager- Technical, Amazon Finance Technology
job_description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Imagine being at the forefront of revolutionizing the tax industry with innovative technologies. As a Principal Product Manager – Technical in the FinTech Tax Technology team, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of tax products and solutions that empower businesses and individuals to navigate the ever-evolving landscape of tax regulations and compliance requirements.  
  
In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for driving the product strategy, technical roadmap, and delivery of our innovative tax product suite. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and subject matter experts, to translate complex tax requirements into robust, scalable, and secure software solutions and ensure our products meet the evolving needs of our customers and comply with complex tax regulations.  
  
Join our team and be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking organization that values excellence, collaboration, and a passion for leveraging technology to simplify the complexities of tax.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Principal Product Manager - Tech, you will lead new, large product initiatives to define the long-term strategy and vision to meet emerging customer needs and tax regulations. You will handle complex product development and business management scenarios, proactively identifying gaps/opportunities to then develop a suite of products to solve the problems.  
  

* Define product strategy, roadmap, and vision for tax product portfolio, while contributing to the technical design of new product features.
* Capture and translate complex tax requirements, regulations, and customer needs into technical specifications, user stories, and innovative user experiences
* Drive alignment across cross-functional teams and tax leadership on product feature, business, and strategies
* Manage end-to-end product development lifecycle
* Build, maintain, and communicate comprehensive product launch plans, tracking deliverables, milestones, risks, and bottlenecks
* Own customer engagement and communication for product updates
* Establish KPIs, identify gaps, and drive continuous improvement of product performance
* Provide mentorship to other product managers on the team

  
About the team  
The Finance Technology Tax team builds technology to support Amazon’s global tax teams (our customers). Our customers need to ensure that Amazon is compliant with the increasingly complex tax regulations. We build systems to enable our customers to perform tax functions including, calculations, payments, filing, tax audits, and recovery at the scale demanded by Amazon’s business operations. We prioritize solutions based on our ability to deliver exponential value in the following four dimensions: 1) supporting business growth while reducing cost to serve 2) ensuring compliance and reducing risk 3) improving customer experience, and 4) providing accurate, complete, and timely data.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience technical product management
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams
* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
