author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
Let’s be real: waiting for a health crisis to start taking care of your body is officially out. Proactive, specialist-led care is the new flex.

Welcome to MetaGO, where we are totally flipping the script on metabolic health and obesity in India. Kyunki scene ye hai, we want to change when India treats these issues, not just how.

Built by the OGs Varun Sheth, Zaheer Adenwala, and Kunal Kapoor—the same trio that scaled Ketto into a massive firm—MetaGO is rooted in one unapologetic truth: nobody should have to fight their biology alone.

Type 2 diabetes and heart disease do not just pop up overnight. They ghost you for years before turning into a full-blown crisis. We are here to intercept them in the talking stage, way before things get messy.

The Playbook

Faltu ka gyan nahi, just pure science.

Every MetaGO journey kicks off with a massive 35+ biomarker deep dive. From there, we bring in the heavy hitters—endocrinologists, cardiologists, and internal medicine experts—to craft a highly personalized roadmap.

Throw in GLP-1 therapies when clinically appropriate, killer fitness coaching, and track it all seamlessly on the MetaGO app. With absolute legends like Dr. Kaushal Patel leading our medical board, apna health scene poora sorted hai.

The Growth & Product Team

Where the GO of MetaGO happens!

This is the engine room. Yahan sirf hustle aur main character energy chalti hai. Everything a member, doctor, coach, or ops teammate touches is cooked up and owned right here.

You are not just shipping minor updates; you are building the entire ecosystem.

Here’s What You’ll Be Driving

* The AI Frontier: We are going full sci-fi. You will be building out next-level AI Health and Fitness Coaches, AI-driven sales flows, predictive AI alerts, content marketing, hyper-intelligent chatbots, human-like AI voice calls, and even tapping into AI video generation. Sab kuch smart, sab kuch next level.

* Omnichannel Tooling: Building the ultimate operating systems that make workflows totally makhan for every internal squad. You will own the CRM and tech for Acquisition, Sales, Customer Success and Support, Medical Operations, and Supply Chain Management.

* The MetaGO App: The daily companion keeping our members on track.

* The Meds Pipeline: The zero-friction logistics network getting meds from a prescription pad straight to a member’s doorstep.

* The Data Brain: The ultimate platform connecting every single consult, lab report, dose, and weigh-in.

What We’re Looking For

* Experience: Years are just a number. If you have worked in the right environment, you have what it takes. But yeah, we definitely want a strong product background.

* Leadership: You enjoy leading from the front and really value stakeholder relationships.

* Strategy: You can lay out a product vision and a multi-year strategy that gets everyone hyped to build.

* Execution: You know how to break down that big strategy into well-prioritized quarterly roadmaps and actually get things done.

* Data-Backed Decisions: You can ask the right questions and let the numbers guide your moves.

* Business Acumen: You are here to build a massive business, not just ship random product features.

* Technical Proficiency: You can sit with the engineering squad and actually influence the design and architecture.

* Fun Personality: People genuinely love working with you. Good vibes only.

* Superstar: That is exactly what we want you to become here at MetaGO.

Picture Abhi Baaki Hai, Mere Dost :)

Our current lineup covers medically supervised GLP-1 and non-GLP-1 programs, diagnostics, and coaching. But with the AI scale and massive product roadmap we are unlocking, honestly, picture abhi baaki hai mere dost :)

We are a fast-moving, high-energy crew that takes massive challenges head-on and owns them to the ground.

If you believe healthcare should start way before the panic sets in, and you want to build the tech that actually makes a dent, we need to talk.

Let’s build something epic together.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**

  

**The Group** : The Retirement business unit focuses on helping individuals achieve better outcomes by working with institutional clients in the global defined contribution and workplace markets. This is a high growth area for Morningstar and houses a diverse product suite and unique client base. By constantly evolving our solutions and solving our client's problems, we believe we are positioned well for continued future growth.

  

**The Role:** Morningstar seeks a Senior Product Manager to work in the Managed Accounts group. Morningstar® Retirement Manager is an online service offered by employers to help their employees save and invest in their workplace retirement accounts. We are looking for an enthusiastic person to lead the team in Mumbai that focuses on core advice recommendation needs for the Retirement Manager application. This requires collaboration across multiple teams both in Mumbai and in Chicago. Familiarity with API development and communicating effectively at all levels is a key requirement. You’ll also bring practical fluency with AI tools and help shape how AI improves both our product and the way our team works.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Act as Product Owner of an Agile scrum team to release functionality on a regular basis
* Write detailed user stories to explain product requirements from a user’s perspective
* Identify relevant business or technical requirements related to a particular user story
* Closely collaborate with engineering, design, and UI/UX to deliver a best-in-class user experience and drive implementation of new product functionality
* Use data to analyze the performance of our flagship solutions and help inform prioritization of product features
* Use AI tools to improve how the team works, such as drafting and refining user stories, synthesizing client feedback, and analyzing product data, and share effective practices with the squad
* Lead and represent the product on client facing discovery and implementation calls
* Understand how the business strategy relates to product strategy and execution
* Support the prioritization of product changes and the creation of the product roadmap
* Partner with engineering and data teams to identify and prioritize where AI can improve the Retirement Manager experience, with appropriate oversight
* undefined
Oversee the operational aspects of the product, including client and user support  

  

**Required Skills and Requirements**

* A passion for retirement planning and helping investors
* Familiarity with development and technical literacy of APIs, integration with external partners
* Ability to translate business and user needs into API capabilities
* Technical experience to effectively communicate with scrum team engineers
* Working fluency with generative AI tools and a practical understanding of where they add value and where human review is essential
* Ability to evaluate AI-enabled opportunities in a regulated financial services setting, including accuracy, transparency, and compliance considerations
* An eye for great user experiences that encourage behavior change and deliver business results
* Ability to communicate and work cross-functionally
* Experience effectively prioritizing and executing tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Knowledge and experience in working with the Agile development framework, including writing user stories
A bachelor’s degree is required  

Morningstar is an equal opportunity Employer

  

If you receive and accept an offer from us, we require that personal and any related investments be disclosed confidentiality to our Compliance team (days vary by region). These investments will be reviewed to ensure they meet Code of Ethics requirements. If any conflicts of interest are identified, then you will be required to liquidate those holdings immediately. In addition, dependent on your department and location of work certain employee accounts must be held with an approved broker (for example all, U.S. employee accounts). If this applies and your account(s) are not with an approved broker, you will be required to move your holdings to an approved broker.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

**Role Summary**

Drive the roadmap and execution of an AI-powered LMS while managing the product development team. Focus on building scalable, user-friendly solutions that improve adoption and learning outcomes across industries.

**Job Description**

* Define and execute product roadmap for AI-driven LMS/LXP
* Manage and align the product development team for timely delivery
* Build AI-powered features such as personalized learning, recommendations, and chatbot interfaces
* Own end-to-end product lifecycle from requirements to release
* Work closely with enterprise clients to gather requirements and tailor solutions
* Drive product customization to suit different industries and use cases
* Prepare effort estimates and scope for new modules, enhancements, and customizations
* Improve user adoption, engagement, and overall experience
* Drive integrations with HRMS, content platforms, and collaboration tools
* Track product performance using data and analytics

**Requirements**

* 4+ years in Product Management (SaaS preferred)
* Experience in LMS, LXP, or HR Tech is a plus
* Strong understanding of AI/ML use cases in products
* Exposure to authoring tools and content creation workflows
* Experience in managing product or cross-functional development teams
* Experience in effort estimation, scoping, and requirement analysis
* Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills

**Good to Have**

* Experience with enterprise clients across industries
* Exposure to chatbot or conversational AI products
* Understanding of learning ecosystems and competency frameworks

**Key KPIs for This Role**

* Release Efficiency: % of features delivered on time vs planned roadmap
* Time to Market: Average time taken from feature finalization to market launch
* Wireframing Effectiveness: Time taken to convert requirements into approved wireframes
* AI Feature Impact: Usage and effectiveness of AI-driven features
* Customization Turnaround: Time taken to scope and deliver client-specific enhancements
* User Engagement: Improvement in completion rates, repeat usage, and session frequency
* Customer Feedback: Reduction in escalations and improvement in satisfaction scores
* Integration Success: Number and stability of integrations delivered
* Team Productivity: Sprint velocity, backlog closure rate, and development cycle time

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

job_description:
Job Title: Senior Product Manager

**Company:** Eminence Technology  
**Location:** Mohali, Punjab  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 Years  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Working Days:** 5 Days a Week  
**Shift:** Night Shift  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About Eminence Technology

Eminence Technology is an IT product and services company focused on delivering innovative, technology-driven solutions. We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Senior Product Manager** to join our team in Mohali and drive product strategy, development, and business growth.

Job Overview

The Senior Product Manager will be responsible for defining product vision, developing product roadmaps, managing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful products. The ideal candidate should have strong business acumen, analytical thinking, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate business requirements into effective product solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Define and execute product strategy, vision, and roadmap in alignment with business objectives.
* Manage the complete product lifecycle, from ideation and requirement gathering to development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, QA, marketing, and other stakeholders to ensure successful product delivery.
* Conduct market research, analyze customer feedback, and identify opportunities for product enhancement.
* Translate business requirements into product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize product features and manage the product backlog based on business priorities and customer needs.
* Work closely with development teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality product features.
* Monitor product performance through KPIs, analytics, and user feedback.
* Communicate product roadmaps, updates, priorities, and progress to stakeholders and senior management.
* Identify opportunities for innovation, process optimization, and improved user experience.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Product Management or a related role.
* Strong understanding of product strategy, roadmap planning, and product lifecycle management.
* Experience in requirement gathering, backlog prioritization, and writing user stories.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar product management platforms.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to work the night shift and from the office in Mohali.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with IT products, SaaS platforms, or technology-driven solutions.
* Exposure to product analytics, market research, and data-driven decision-making.
* Experience managing multiple priorities and aligning product initiatives with business goals.
* **Excellent verbal and written communication skills**, with the ability to confidently present product strategies, communicate with stakeholders, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

Work Schedule

* **Working Days:** 5 days a week
* **Shift:** Night shift
* **Work Mode:** Work from office (On-site)
* **Location:** Mohali, Punjab

How to Apply

If you are passionate about product innovation, strategic planning, and delivering customer-focused solutions, we would love to hear from you!

Apply now to join **Eminence Technology** as a **Senior Product Manager** and contribute to building impactful technology solutions.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

* Translate business requirements into product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritize product features and manage the product backlog based on business priorities and customer needs.

Required Skills and Qualifications

If you are passionate about product innovation, strategic planning, and delivering customer-focused solutions, we would love to hear from you!

**Company Description**

**Strategy (Nasdaq: MSTR)** is at the forefront of transforming organizations into intelligent enterprises through data-driven innovation. We don't just follow trends—we set them and drive change. As a market leader in enterprise analytics and AI software, we've pioneered the BI and analytics space, empowering people to make better decisions and revolutionizing how businesses operate. We are now also at the forefront of AI disruption, providing data via our enterprise semantic layer to AI agents, tools, and platforms.

But that's not all. Strategy is also leading a groundbreaking shift in digital assets, adopting bitcoin as our primary treasury reserve asset in 2020. Since then, we have issued innovative bitcoin-backed securities and have been the leader in bitcoin treasury companies. This visionary move has helped us build a fortress balance sheet, and is solidifying our position as a forward-thinking, innovative force in the market.

Our people are the core of our success. At Strategy, you'll join a team of smart, creative minds working on dynamic projects with cutting-edge technologies. We thrive on curiosity, innovation, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

Our corporate values—bold, agile, engaged, impactful, and united—are the foundation of our culture. As we lead the charge into the new era of AI and financial innovation, we foster an environment where every employee's contributions are recognized and valued.

Join us and be part of an organization that lives and breathes innovation every day. At Strategy, you're not just another employee, you're a crucial part of a mission to push the boundaries of analytics and redefine financial investment.

 **Job Description**

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Product Manager to build next-generation B2B data, analytics, cloud, and AI products. You’ll go deep into technology, understand customer problems, challenge assumptions, and turn complex ideas into simple, high-impact products.

You will own the product end-to-end: vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, execution, launch, and adoption. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, QE, Cloud Operations, Sales, and customers to deliver scalable, high-performing, differentiated products.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Discovery & Strategy:** Engage deeply with customers to understand pain points and opportunities. Use qualitative and quantitative data to shape product vision and strategy
* **Roadmap & Prioritization:** Own and refine the product roadmap and backlog. Prioritize work based on customer value, business impact, and strategic goals
* **Execution & Delivery:** Work daily with Engineering, Architecture, Design, QE, and Cloud Ops in agile teams. Manage trade-offs, dependencies, and timelines to ship high-quality products
* **Adoption & Outcomes:** Define clear success metrics and instrument product analytics. Partner with Sales, CS, and Marketing to drive adoption and measure post-launch impact
* **Continuous Improvement:** Monitor performance, gather customer feedback, and analyze competition. Iterate to improve usability, performance, and business outcomes

**How You Think**

* You think in **products, not projects**
* You start with the **problem, not the feature**
* You understand technology under the hood: architecture, APIs, data, cloud
* You are **data-driven**, using metrics like funnels, adoption, and retention to make decisions
* You simplify complex problems and care about **performance, scalability, quality, and UX**
* You are resilient, accountable, and follow through on what you commit to
* You value thoughtful design and recognize its impact on adoption and satisfaction
* You collaborate effectively and are comfortable challenging the status quo

**Requirements**

* 6+ years of strong Product Management experience,
* Proven experience building B2B data, analytics, cloud, or AI products
* Strong understanding of: SQL-based applications , Cloud data platforms, AI/ML fundamentals, Data governance and data quality
* Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, and cloud technologies
* Exceptional product judgment and end-to-end ownership of products
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and prioritization skills
* Strong customer focus, with demonstrated ability to translate customer problems into impactful products
* Excellent communication skills, comfortable engaging stakeholders from engineering to executive leadership

**Additional Information**

The recruitment process includes online assessment as a first step (logic) - we send it via e-mail, please check also your SPAM folder

job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

 **Job Description**

The Senior Product Manager I will help shape and advance reporting capabilities for Nielsen's Ads and Outcomes measurement portfolio. These products help clients understand advertising performance, audience delivery, and business outcomes through clear, trusted, and actionable insights. The role will help bring together customer needs, data, design, technology, and AI to create experiences that make complex measurement easier to explore and use.

You will own product work from discovery through launch and adoption. You will work with product, engineering, design, and client-facing teams. The ideal candidate is a self-starter. You create structure in ambiguous situations. You move initiatives forward. You make practical decisions based on customer needs, business value, data, and technical feasibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define product direction for assigned areas in alignment with business goals and customer needs.
* Translate customer, market, and commercial insights into clear product opportunities; partner with Design and Engineering to shape scalable solutions.
* Own the roadmap and backlog, making prioritization and trade-off decisions; develop product requirements, and prototypes.
* Lead initiatives through discovery, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Use research customer feedback to guide decisions; build alignment across the organization to move these decisions forward through influence.
* Ensure product experiences are consistent across user interfaces, APIs, and other delivery channels.
* Define product goals, KPIs, and adoption measures, and use them to evaluate impact.
* Identify high-value opportunities to apply AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify workflows and improve customer outcomes.
* Shape connected AI product experiences that bring together related data and insights to help users answer broader business questions.
* Contribute to a strong product culture by sharing knowledge, supporting teams, and raising the quality of product thinking.

  
**Qualifications**  

* 6+ years of experience in product management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred; a Master’s degree is a plus.
* Experience in SaaS, DaaS, analytics, data products, or enterprise software.
* Experience taking complex initiatives from concept through launch and adoption, guiding collaborative teams and influencing without formal authority.
* Experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to understand data models, data flows, metrics, and measurement methodologies.
* Modern AI aptitude, including familiarity with model evaluation, prompt design, MCP, and agentic workflows.
* Comfortable using AI tools to support requirements, user experience design, research, and documentation.
* Experience applying customer feedback, product usage data, and business results to guide prioritization and UI initiatives.
* Familiarity with Agile product development and tools such as Jira, Confluence, Aha, analytics platforms, or prototyping tools.
* Experience in ad tech, audience measurement, or media analytics is preferred.
* Ability to explain complex topics to technical, commercial, executive, and customer audiences.
* Self-directed, organized, and comfortable creating structure in ambiguous situations.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

  
**Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

job_description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Product Manager- TechnicalOverview  
MasterCard Data & Services enables customers across industries and geographies to make smarter decisions and reach better outcomes with a tailored portfolio of solutions beyond the transaction.  
• We harness the power of real-time, anonymized, aggregated transaction data; powerful software platforms; and a wealth of expertise• We empower customers to make better data-driven decisions by unlocking a holistic view of consumer behaviour beyond their four walls and distilling actionable insights from data• We work with financial institutions, retailers, telecommunications organizations, travel companies, and moreThe MasterCard Data & Services Operational Insights Program Global Product Management team is seeking an accomplished technology-focused Product Manager to support the evolution of its products. This person will be part of a team of product managers that oversee key activities including execution of the product strategy, management of the roadmap, shaping the product platform architecture and the creation of technical requirements leading to building and commercialisation of products and services. This individual will partner closely with other Global Product Management team members to support the development of the product strategy and ensure product priorities are well-aligned with commercial objectives. This individual will also be the key collaborator with the Platform team to shape the long-term technical vision for the product and ensure efficient development execution. Product Managers in Data & Services at Mastercard • Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value • Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products• Ensure the technical success of our products through close partnerships with Technology teams• Drive globally relevant solutions by understanding regional needs and trade-offs, and building scalable products that serve an array of customer segments• Set product direction with coordination, not in isolation—taking into account how our products all work together to serve customer needs  
  
Role  

* Own, define and deliver end-to-end strategy for multiple features for the products from inception to launch
* Design and conduct user research, including customer interviews, to deepen understanding of customers’ pain points, motivations and opportunities
* Work closely with engineering teams, designers, and operational teams to prioritize development efforts as they align against product strategy

• Determine release goals for the platforms and prioritize assigned features•  
Ensure consistent alignment between business priorities and development objectives  

* Oversee timely and high-quality execution of the creation of technical requirements
* Build strong working relationships with a diverse group of internal and external stakeholders to achieve product goals
* Translate business priorities into clear, actionable technical requirements for the engineering team
* Identify issues that will keep the platform features from delivering on time and/or with the desired requirement and communicate to the leadership
* Promote internal and external feature adoption
* Partner with internal teams to answer product questions and provide product support
* Provide input into product pricing and our go-to-market strategy
* Exhibit expertise within the platform feature area and coordinate with interdependent teams

  
All About You  

* Proficient agile product management experience in analytical products and business intelligence solutions
* Extensive experience in managing analytical solutions designed for payments or related financial services sectors preferred
* Analytical, solutions-oriented skillset with the ability to drive thought leadership
* Experience designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer, an outstanding user experience and stickiness
* Requires minimal supervision/assistance
* Keen understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends in the data monetization, self-service analytics and predictive insights space, and the ability to translate that understanding into meaningful actions and enhancements
* Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills including the ability to interface with clients
* Highly organized and able to deal with multiple and competing priorities

• Knowledge and skills using product management tools, (e.g., market and product plans, project timelines, marketing research, pricing, business case development)•
  
Bachelor’s degree in business or relevant experience  

* Technical background (e.g., Computer Science or related field) a plus

• Experience in the payments industry with data insights a plus• Certifications in product management and agile processes will be an added advantage  

* An advanced degree is helpful

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Product Manager - Product Adoption, Insights & AI
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager - Product Adoption, Insights & AI** 
 
**The Opportunity**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Are you an experienced Product Manager with strong analytical skills, strategic thinking, and a passion for turning data into action? If so, join our team and help shape how Nutanix measures product adoption, customer value realization, and business outcomes across our portfolio.

In this role, you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for Product Adoption & Insights. You will partner closely with Product Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to build trusted adoption metrics, actionable insights, and AI-powered recommendations that help improve customer adoption, retention, and growth.

### **Your Role:**

* Define and drive strategy and roadmap for Product Adoption & Insights initiatives across the Nutanix portfolio.
* Partner with Product Managers, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, Engineering, and Corporate Strategy teams to gather requirements and identify opportunities to improve adoption, customer health, and value realization.
* Define and evolve adoption frameworks, telemetry requirements, customer health metrics, and executive reporting.
* Build AI-powered actionable insights that help Customer Success and Account teams proactively identify risks and opportunities.
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and stakeholder interviews to identify new opportunities and drive prioritization.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and enablement across Product, Customer Success, Field, and Corporate Strategy organizations.

### **What You Will Bring:**

* B.E./M.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field is required. MBA preferred.
* 7+ years of overall experience, including 5+ years in Product Management. Experience in Product Adoption, Product Analytics, telemetry, insights, or related data-driven products is highly desirable.
* Strong experience in strategy, roadmap planning, stakeholder management, and product execution.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and business stakeholders.
* Familiarity with telemetry, product usage analytics, AI-powered recommendations, customer health metrics, or business intelligence solutions is preferred.
* Self-motivated with strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.

### **About the Team**

This role reports to the Director of Product Management, responsible for Product Adoption & Insights, NIVA (Nutanix Intelligent Virtual Agent), Customer Success, and Professional Services Strategy.

The team focuses on helping customers realize value faster through trusted adoption insights, AI-powered recommendations, customer success innovations, and strategic services offerings.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India, and follows a hybrid work model.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

**Role Overview**
=================

We are seeking a technically strong and execution-oriented Technical Product Manager to help advance the Windchill+ SaaS platform. The role partners closely with Product Management, Platform R&D, Quality Assurance, Cloud Engineering, and service operations teams to translate platform requirements into well-defined, executable development backlogs.

The immediate focus is platform release execution performed directly with R&D teams. This includes release readiness, technical improvements, security and compliance changes, infrastructure evolution, validation, retrofitting, and other work required to advance and maintain the platform. The TPM will operate under the mentorship of the lead Windchill+ Platform TPM while progressively assuming ownership of recurring backlog, dependency, and release-management responsibilities.

Over time, the role will expand into broader service-level improvements. The TPM will help define how platform capabilities affect the Windchill+ service experience and will apply Design for Operations thinking earlier in the development lifecycle. Design for Operations is an evolving practice within the organization, and this role will help establish practical ways to incorporate operational requirements, installed-base impacts, customer enablement, and service readiness into backlog definition.

  

**Responsibilities**
====================

  

The responsibilities below represent a superset of the work this role may perform. Actual day-to-day focus will vary over the course of any given release and across releases. The TPM is not expected to perform all of these responsibilities all of the time, or to do so without support from the broader team.

* Partner directly with Windchill+ Platform R&D teams to define, refine, prioritize, and maintain executable product backlogs.

* Translate product, service, security, compliance, and operational requirements into clear deliverables, epics, stories, acceptance criteria, and release outcomes.

* Own day-to-day TPM execution for assigned platform initiatives through discovery, planning, development, validation, and release.

* Coordinate platform readiness for Windchill product releases, maintenance releases, security updates, supporting component changes, and installed-base retrofits.

* Work with engineering and QA leads to assess technical approaches, dependencies, resource needs, delivery estimates, validation requirements, and release feasibility.

* Lead backlog refinement and support sprint planning, PI planning, release planning, story acceptance, and TPM readouts with globally distributed Agile teams.

* Manage work across Product Management, Platform R&D, QA, Cloud Engineering, operations, integrated products, and shared services, converting dependencies into explicit backlog and accountable ownership.

* Facilitate technical discovery and design spikes when requirements, architecture, or operational impacts are not sufficiently understood.

* Maintain a reliable view of planned, completed, deferred, and at-risk work; identify decisions and escalations early enough to protect delivery.

* Balance urgent tactical needs with longer-term platform objectives and roadmap priorities.

* Begin applying Design for Operations to assigned work by considering provisioning, configuration, monitoring, support, maintenance, security, upgrades, retrofitting, validation, and customer enablement during backlog definition.

* Continuously strengthen technical and product-management expertise through hands-on collaboration, mentoring, and formal or self-directed learning.

**Growth Opportunities**
========================

As experience and organizational practices mature, the TPM will expand from hands-on platform execution into broader service-level ownership:

* Independently manage multiple platform workstreams across releases, including more complex cross-team and installed-base changes.

* Lead selected Design for Operations assessments and help evolve the organization's methods, templates, and working practices.

* Define how proposed capabilities change the experience for customers, administrators, partners, support teams, and service operators.

* Own selected service improvements from definition through release, connecting the intended service experience to the required platform, automation, documentation, enablement, and operational backlog.

* Partner with the Offering Owner on changes that affect the Service Guide, service catalog, customer commitments, or broader offering definition.

* Provide broader Windchill+ TPM coverage, enabling the lead platform TPM to concentrate on strategic, cross-offering, and technically complex initiatives.

**Skills and Knowledge**
========================

**Required**
------------

* Strong experience with enterprise software development, platform engineering, cloud services, DevOps, systems integration, or SaaS delivery teams.

* Demonstrated ability to translate technical and business requirements into an executable Agile backlog.

* Experience writing deliverables, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.

* Experience prioritizing backlogs and performing story or release acceptance.

* Working knowledge of Scrum, Agile planning, backlog refinement, and iterative software delivery.

* Ability to understand complex technical dependencies and drive decisions across multiple engineering and stakeholder teams.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with developers, architects, QA engineers, operations teams, Product Managers, and senior stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently while maintaining alignment across globally distributed teams.

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, science, mathematics, or an equivalent technical discipline.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Windchill installation, deployment, administration, integrations, or functional capabilities.

* Experience with Microsoft Azure or other public or private cloud platforms.

* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, DevOps pipelines, infrastructure automation, Docker, Kubernetes, or enterprise application deployment technologies.

* Familiarity with Java-based enterprise application architectures, REST APIs, scripting, Linux, and secure communication technologies.

* Experience with Jira or similar requirements and backlog management systems.

* Understanding of application security, compliance, identity and access management, monitoring, and operational validation.

* Experience supporting SaaS releases, platform updates, maintenance releases, security updates, or installed-base retrofits.

* Exposure to service design, operational readiness, or product-to-operations transition practices.

**Experience**
==============

* Typically 6 or more years of relevant experience in enterprise software development, technical product management, engineering delivery, cloud services, systems integration, deployment, or customer-facing technical roles.

* Formal Product Manager or Product Owner experience is valuable but is not required when the candidate has demonstrated ownership of complex technical delivery and engineering backlog.

* Experience coordinating work across multiple teams or systems is strongly preferred.

* The candidate should be comfortable starting in a hands-on execution role and growing into broader service-level ownership.

  
  

Life at PTC is about more than working with today’s most cutting-edge technologies to transform the physical world. It’s about showing up as you are and working alongside some of today’s most talented industry leaders to transform the world around you.

If you share our passion for problem-solving through innovation, you’ll likely become just as passionate about the PTC experience as we are. Are you ready to explore your next career move with us?

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."

title: Product Manager - Senior Vice President
job_description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Digital PM Group Manager is accountable for management of complex/critical/large professional disciplinary areas. Leads and directs a team of professionals. Requires a comprehensive understanding of multiple areas within a function and how they interact in order to achieve the objectives of the function. Applies in-depth understanding of the business impact of technical contributions. Strong commercial awareness is a necessity. Generally accountable for delivery of a full range of services to one or more businesses/ geographic regions. Excellent communication skills required in order to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Some external communication may be necessary. Accountable for the end results of an area. Exercises control over resources, policy formulation and planning. Primarily affects a sub-function. Involved in short- to medium-term planning of actions and resources for own area. Full management responsibility of a team or multiple teams, including management of people, budget and planning, to include performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary actions and terminations and budget approval.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead a team of Product Managers and engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to conceive, design and develop innovative financial platform products
* Responsible for the overall vision, technical capabilities and roadmap of the digital product platform
* Engage with businesses and shape business and product requirements in to platform requirements
* Own the overall platform business plans and roadmaps
* Drive product development for new initiatives
* Make appropriate tradeoffs to optimize time-to-market
* Maintain the product roadmap, and clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities and desired outcomes throughout the company
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

  
**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience
* Experience shaping business strategy for technical products or services
* Responsive, flexible and able to succeed within an open collaborative peer environment
* Excellent product and platform instincts and communication skills coupled with a passion for business, technology while delivering a world-class customer experience
* Demonstrated track record managing all aspects of a successful software or technology product or platform throughout its lifecycle, including product strategy development, customer insights/needs, and requirements definition
* Data-driven analytical skills and be able to operate and thrive with partial information and ambiguity and have a track record of building successful teams
* Demonstrated ability to define, prioritize and deliver best in class software service products
* Thinks strategically, but stays on top of tactical execution
* Capacity to develop, and maintain comprehensive set of business plans and financial models
* Ability to succeed in a cross-matrixed organization that relies on building support in other groups
* Capacity to adapt to shifting goals and activities
* Capacity to manage multiple activities in parallel
* Self-starter with the ability to define goals and strategies with minimal management oversight
* Willingness to take risks to develop a business in unchartered waters

  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred
  

  
  
This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.  

-

**Job Family Group:**
---------------------

Product Management and Development

-

**Job Family:**
---------------

Digital Product Management

-

**Time Type:**
--------------

Full time

-

**Most Relevant Skills**
------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.

-

**Other Relevant Skills**
-------------------------

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

-

*Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.

You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Working with people**

* Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
* Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
* Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment

### **Building the roadmap**

* Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
* Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
* Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
* Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
* Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform

### **Building the feature**

* Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
* Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
* Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
* Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
* Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
* Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
* Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
* Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
* See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems

### **Shipping the feature**

* Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
* Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
* Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
* Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
* Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
* Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
* B2B SaaS experience is a must
* Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
* Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
* Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
* You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
* You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

**Why You Want To Work Here**
-----------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* ESOPs
* Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
* Flexible leave program
* Home workstation setup allowance
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
* Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

**Why You Want To Work Here**
-----------------------------

* Competitive compensation
* ESOPs
* Remote working, with an option to rent coworking spaces
* Flexible leave program
* Home workstation setup allowance
* A culture built on trust, transparency, and integrity
* Ground floor opportunity at a fast-growing Series A startup

title: Senior Product Manager (1) - IN B
job_description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Product Managers at U.S. Bank are customer obsessed in driving product visioning, planning and development to deliver on our human + digital product strategy and staying one step ahead of evolving economic, technological, and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will:
  

* Identify, analyze and interpret business data using various kinds of techniques to meet business needs and requirements.
* Activate the connective tissue between U.S. Bank, customer experience, digital, technology, and business line strategy to identify and prioritize product / portfolio opportunities, and establish the product vision, charter and roadmap.
* Defines product outcomes and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) to prioritize Features/Epics and breaks down work into actionable steps to facilitate product discovery, design, development and delivery.
* Manages the end-to-end product lifecycle and drives the product roadmap leveraging OKRs (Objectives and Key Results).
* Creates the product in conjunction with agile, experience design, technology and risk partners to achieve business and customer outcomes.
* In the case of technical products, understands and cares for the technical features, debt reduction and modernization of the technical product with expertise in the technology required of the product

Basic Qualifications
  

* Typically requires Bachelor's degree
* Twelve or more years of experience

  
Preferred Skills/Experience
  

* Expertise on the critical interdependencies among product model system elements that help and hinder performance; ability to plan and design solutions that synchronize resources to achieve business results using business metrics, key performance indicators, design systems, service blueprints, and reusability
* Ability to anticipate shifting market priorities, internal and external customer needs in a manner that consistently adds value
* Strong customer centricity to implement strategies and techniques used to ensure that customers have a positive experience with the organization's products and services at every touch point
* Knowledge of technical aspects of software products; ability to design, configure and integrate technical aspects of software products
* Knowledge of Agile ways of working, knowledge of processes, tools and techniques for assessing and controlling an organization's exposure to risks of various kinds; ability to apply knowledge of risk management appropriately to diverse situations
* Preferred skills: product PnL, product strategy, vision and planning, product discovery, product development, channel alignment and management, adoption, customer experience research, insight and execution, agile ways of working, go to market and sales channels, performance measurement and optimization, marketing and analytics, customer centricity

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

**Posting may be closed earlier due to high volume of applicants.**

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

title: Senior Product Manager - Core Risk
job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**About the team and the role:**

The Core Risk Product team’s vision is to ensure eBay remains a trusted marketplace for our customers by building advanced risk management capabilities and intuitive experiences that enable legitimate sellers and buyers to transact with confidence, while proactively preventing fraudulent and abusive behavior by sellers & buyers.

  
  

You would be part of a world class product organization with a strong product management culture. You would be the leader of the product that you own to shape the strategy going forward.

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to help define and execute the product strategy for Core Risk management. You will drive initiatives end-to-end, from customer discovery to launch, working cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, research, communications, policy, legal, finance, and other partner teams.

**What you will accomplish:**

* Create Product Strategy & Vision - You will be responsible for the holistic vision and end-to-end execution of key product solutions for our customers; develop and effectively champion a data-driven and market-informed product strategy that aligns to our eBay corporate strategy and delivers tangible outcomes for our Sellers and the eBay business
* Obsess the Customer & Overall Quality of Experiences - Demonstrate a steadfast focus on listening to our end-users and feed their voice into the customer-centric design process. Leverage design and research partnerships to get insights and feedback throughout the entire product lifecycle. Build processes for continuous improvement.
* Break Down Silos & Enable Tight-knit Collaboration - Create connections and processes across teams that will drive efficient cross-team collaboration and clear alignment. Primary teams this role partners with outside of the risk product team include risk policy, decision science, analytics, design, and marketing.
* Empower Teams To Rapidly Prioritize & Implement - Build in processes to ensure execution with speed and transparency. Inspire a “decide and go” mentality across your team to prioritize and propel the development process forward to hit our outcomes. Partner closely with Program Management to manage through blockers and communicate dates and milestones
* Build risk capabilities needed across eBay, eBay Live and its subsidiaries

**What you will bring:**

* 5+ years of proven experience building products, deep expertise in customer focused product management and product development lifecycle. Experience with risk or trust management on online marketplaces and eCommerce platforms preferred.
* Technical depth and proven experience with building engaging, customer-focused end-to-end UX experiences; designing elegant solutions to complex problems that require integrations with multiple platforms, domains and services; and driving analysis of qualitative and quantitative data and metrics to derive opportunities, gaps, and solutions
* Experience managing multiple complex, multi-phase strategic products in parallel with the ability to manage matrixed teams in a global context to successful delivery and excellence. Proven ability and in-market examples of defining a strategic vision for a new and innovative portfolio of products that drove significant impact for millions of end users at a global scale
* Deep understanding of the product development lifecycle from planning through deployment; experience leveraging test and validation frameworks throughout the product lifecycle. Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies and working in Agile teams is desirable
* Must have a passion for our sellers and the relentless drive to improve experiences for our sellers, influencing a higher bar on quality and ensuring the seller is always at the center of our product roadmap and priorities. Experience working with design research and qualitative tools to ensure the voice of our seller is at the center of our product development
* Strong, concise communicator and effective story-teller; experience using both analytics and qualitative research to express the vision and strategy of the product
* Bachelors or masters degree in Engineering or Business management.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.

  

We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

Apply Now

title: Engineering Product Manager
job_description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.
* Technical depth sufficient to earn the trust of principal engineers, whether from an engineering background or from years spent close to one.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year
  
  

* Every product in the current integrating portfolio has a named owner, a dated plan, and a published integration tier.
* The platform engagement checklist is live, and new products start on it by default.
* A majority of new integrations reach production without hands-on platform support.
* Time to integrate is measured, published, and trending down.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

job_description:
**Principal Product Manager – Core Intelligence and Optimization**

**Target in India | L7 Individual Contributor**

**About the Job – Principal Product Manager, Core Intelligence and Optimization**

Target’s stores operate at extraordinary scale and complexity. Every day, millions of signals across inventory, workload, space, team member activity and physical environments create opportunities to make smarter operational decisions.

As a **Principal Product Manager for Core Intelligence and Optimization**, you will help shape how Target turns those signals into intelligence.

You will be a senior product thought leader working across Core Intelligence to identify and solve some of Target’s hardest problems at the intersection of **AI, data science, operational intelligence, recommendation, optimization and automation**.

Your role will extend beyond any single product. You will explore emerging opportunities, frame ambiguous problems, incubate new intelligence capabilities and connect products across the intelligence lifecycle—from understanding operational context through recommendation and optimization.

You will influence Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX and Operations leaders across the enterprise and help shape Target's evolving approach to intelligent Store systems.

**Core Intelligence Optimization Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Shape long-term product thinking for Core Intelligence and identify emerging opportunities across intelligent systems, AI/ML, recommendation, optimization and automation.
* Develop strong product perspectives on how Target can use operational and physical signals to create differentiated Store intelligence.
* Identify complex, cross-cutting problems where intelligence can create meaningful value for guests, team members and Store operations.
* Translate ambiguous opportunities into clear problem spaces, hypotheses and product strategies.
* Help determine where Target should build reusable intelligence capabilities versus domain-specific solutions.

**Discovery, Experimentation & Incubation**

* Lead discovery for emerging intelligence opportunities that span existing product or organizational boundaries.
* Partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX and Operations to explore problems and potential solutions.
* Use simulation, experimentation, prototypes and data to rapidly validate hypotheses.
* Incubate new intelligence capabilities until there is sufficient evidence and clarity to scale.
* Establish measurable feedback loops that connect intelligence and recommendations to operational outcomes.
* Challenge teams to demonstrate value and learning before scaling investment.

**Enterprise Product Leadership**

* Connect intelligence capabilities across products and experiences to create coherent, reusable systems rather than isolated solutions.
* Influence product strategy and investment decisions across multiple Product groups.
* Navigate complex technical, operational and organizational trade-offs.
* Communicate sophisticated intelligence concepts in clear language that enables senior leaders to make decisions.
* Serve as a trusted product thought partner to Product Directors and senior PTUX leaders.

**Elevate Product Craft**

* Raise the quality of product discovery, strategy, experimentation and outcome measurement across Core Intelligence.
* Coach and mentor Product Managers without direct people-management responsibility.
* Introduce product practices appropriate for AI/ML and intelligence products where outputs may be probabilistic and continuously learning.
* Help teams move from feature and solution thinking toward problem, outcome and capability thinking.
* Build reusable frameworks that strengthen product decision-making across the organization.

**About You**

* 4-year college degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree is a plus.
* 8+ years of Product Management experience with significant experience solving highly complex product problems.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with AI/ML, data products, recommendation systems, optimization, intelligent platforms or similarly complex technical domains is strongly preferred.
* Exceptional problem framing, systems thinking and product judgment.
* Strong discovery and experimentation mindset.
* Ability to translate emerging technology into meaningful customer and business opportunities.
* Proven ability to influence senior Product, Technology, Data Science and business leaders without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal storytelling skills.
* Thrives in ambiguity and is energized by problems where the answer has not yet been defined.

* Translate ambiguous opportunities into clear problem spaces, hypotheses and product strategies.
* Help determine where Target should build reusable intelligence capabilities versus domain-specific solutions.

* Lead discovery for emerging intelligence opportunities that span existing product or organizational boundaries.
* Partner deeply with Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, UX and Operations to explore problems and potential solutions.
* Use simulation, experimentation, prototypes and data to rapidly validate hypotheses.
* Incubate new intelligence capabilities until there is sufficient evidence and clarity to scale.
* Establish measurable feedback loops that connect intelligence and recommendations to operational outcomes.
* Challenge teams to demonstrate value and learning before scaling investment.

* Connect intelligence capabilities across products and experiences to create coherent, reusable systems rather than isolated solutions.
* Influence product strategy and investment decisions across multiple Product groups.

* Coach and mentor Product Managers without direct people-management responsibility.
* Introduce product practices appropriate for AI/ML and intelligence products where outputs may be probabilistic and continuously learning.
* Help teams move from feature and solution thinking toward problem, outcome and capability thinking.
* Build reusable frameworks that strengthen product decision-making across the organization.

**About You**

* 8+ years of Product Management experience with significant experience solving highly complex product problems.
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor across organizational boundaries.
* Experience with AI/ML, data products, recommendation systems, optimization, intelligent platforms or similarly complex technical domains is strongly preferred.
