* Strong discovery and experimentation mindset.
* Ability to translate emerging technology into meaningful customer and business opportunities.
* Proven ability to influence senior Product, Technology, Data Science and business leaders without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal storytelling skills.
* Thrives in ambiguity and is energized by problems where the answer has not yet been defined.

job_description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

**Position Summary**: We are looking for a **Senior Product Manager** to join our Value-Based Care Analytics & Performance team within our Clinicals division in **Bangalore**. In this role you will be responsible for defined problem spaces within the VBC Analytics & Performance roadmap, developing deep expertise in our users, customers, and workflows and ensuring product features meet business requirements. You will help define how AI is responsibly integrated into VBC analytics workflows, ensuring solutions are safe, trustworthy, and deliver measurable value to healthcare practices.

You will work closely with scrum teams defining and writing user stories, prioritizing product backlogs, and making trade-off decisions between scope and schedule. Your work will span both strengthening our current solutions and delivering innovative, AI-driven features that improve user experience and clinical decision-making. Success in this role will be measured by improvements in clinical outcomes, user satisfaction, product quality, and safe adoption of AI-enabled capabilities.

**About the Team**: The Value-Based Care Analytics & Performance team brings together Product Management, Engineering, User Experience, Product Analytics, Data Science, and Patient Safety partners to drive industry-leading outcomes and optimize revenue in value-based care arrangements. The team works across product strategy, execution, and measurement to deliver both core product capabilities and AI-enabled solutions where they add value. This role will support that mission by helping shape product decisions and delivery for an assigned area.

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Drive product vision incorporating AI-enabled capabilities, predictive insights, and automation opportunities.
* Translate product strategy into outcome-based roadmaps that connect customer problems, business goals, delivery priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Lead early-stage discovery, including identifying high-value use cases, validating concepts with users and stakeholders, and defining data requirements and feasibility.
* Define epics and user stories that clearly articulate functional requirements, user experience considerations, data and model requirements, and AI behavior expectations.
* Work directly with scrum teams to prioritize work and ensure delivery of both core and AI-enabled product capabilities.
* Participate in scrum ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, readouts, and retrospectives.
* Own ongoing maintenance of core products, including triaging production issues and managing enhancements.
* Define product success metrics for each major initiative, including adoption, engagement, workflow efficiency, customer satisfaction, safety, and business impact.
* Monitor post-release performance and use product analytics, customer feedback, and operational data to guide iteration and prioritization.
* Partner with UX, Analytics, and Data Science teams to define measurement strategies for AI feature performance including validity, bias, data quality, adoption, and impact.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering to manage the full AI/ML lifecycle, including model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Champion responsible AI practices including safety testing, bias evaluation, and explainability.
* Own go-to-market strategies for assigned products, including AI-enabled features.
* Gain alignment from multiple stakeholders, manage product dependencies, and negotiate trade-offs across product areas.
* Understand dependencies across athenaOne and collaborate with Product Management peers to coordinate work across related product areas.
* Engage with Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding, and Product Marketing to gather insights, communicate product direction, and support adoption.
* Communicate product strategy, priorities, progress, and risks to senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Contribute product knowledge to strengthen product management practices and support the development of colleagues.

**Expected Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree required; Degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field preferred. Masters preferred.
* 10+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 6+ years in Product Management
* Demonstrated success establishing product vision, priorities, and roadmaps, and owning complex product problems from discovery through delivery and measurement
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams, navigate ambiguity, and make clear decisions about where to focus
* Ability to build alignment across stakeholders, manage dependencies, and make informed trade-offs among customer needs, business objectives, and delivery considerations
* Experience working with Agile/Scrum engineering teams as a Product Owner
* Experience defining and using product metrics and validation methods to assess customer value and inform decisions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex topics understandable to customers, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners
* Understanding of healthcare/health IT environments and clinical workflows, or ability to quickly develop domain expertise
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts, responsible AI principles, model bias, explainability, and the full AI/ML lifecycle
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate product development work, with appropriate human review
* Technical understanding of data, APIs, and SaaS - ability to assess feasibility and remove development barriers

**Additional Information**

Some travel to the US may be required for customer site visits, internal collaborations and industry events (5%)

***About athenahealth***

***Our vision:*** *In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*

***Our company culture:*** *Our talented* *employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.*

***Our DEI commitment:*** *Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*

***What we can do for you:***

*Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative* *workspaces* — *some offices even welcome dogs.*

*We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment,* *full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth* *enables* *employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.*

*In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.*

*Learn more about our culture and benefits here:* *athenahealth.com/careers*

*https://www.athenahealth.com/careers/equal-opportunity*

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (Travel Tech Industry Experience mandatory)
job_description:
**About the role**
------------------

Kapture CX is looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own guest experience, reservation, inventory management products for enterprise customers in the cruise, airline and hospitality space.

You will work with customers' business teams to understand how they sell and service their products, and turn that into product strategy, specs and designs that engineering teams build and ship. The ideal candidate combines travel/cruiseline -domain depth, technical fluency and strong stakeholder management.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Product strategy and ownership**

* Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for the Central Reservation System and corresponding modules.
* Translate customer business needs and pain points into prioritised product initiatives with clear outcomes.
* Balance customer requests, platform scalability and technical debt when setting priorities.
* Track industry trends and competitor products in travel and hospitality tech. (Good to have)

### **Technical product delivery**

* Write PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria; create product workflows and designs for engineering teams.
* Lead cross-functional development and QA teams through sprint planning, release and UAT.
* Work with architects on APIs, integrations, data models and non-functional requirements such as performance and scalability.
* Use prototypes to validate requirements with customers before full build.

### **Data and continuous improvement**

* Define product KPIs and track adoption, performance and business impact.
* Use SQL and analytics tools to analyse product data, validate system behaviour and find improvement opportunities.
* Drive root-cause analysis of production issues and data-quality gaps.

### **Customer and stakeholder management**

* Run discovery workshops with enterprise customers to understand processes, pain points and goals.
* Present roadmaps, release plans and product performance to senior customer and internal stakeholders.
* Manage critical issues and escalations through to resolution.
* Identify where AI and automation (AI Voice, Chat, Agent Assist, Intelligent Workflows) can improve booking and servicing journeys.

**Key requirements**
--------------------

* 5-10 years of total experience, with 3+ years in product management (5+ years for the Senior level).
* Domain experience in cruise line, airline or hospitality technology. **(Mandatory)**
* Hands-on experience with a Central Reservation System, booking engine or reservations platform.
* Working knowledge of inventory management, pricing and distribution concepts.
* Technical fluency with REST APIs, integrations, data models and SQL.
* Experience leading cross-functional engineering and QA teams in an agile environment.
* Experience working with enterprise B2B customers and senior stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, documentation and communication skills.
* Shift timing will be 3pm to 12am as the primary market would be US/EU. **(Mandate & should be comfortable in working)**

**Good to have**
----------------

* Experience with travel platforms or standards such as GDS, OTA integrations or OpenTravel.
* Background in B2B SaaS, CRM or contact-centre platforms.
* Exposure to revenue management, demand forecasting or AI/ML in travel.
* Experience with data warehouses and BI tools.
* Experience with prototyping tools
* Prior experience in customer success or account management.

**Job Title**

Senior Product Owner

### **In this role, you’ll:**

* Apply your technical or functional expertise to support business goals and guide others in your area of knowledge.
* Collaborate with teammates to shape product direction and deliver value across different teams and departments.
* Translate product goals into clear and actionable requirements, working with finance, security, operations, support, and other key stakeholders.
* Partner with Product Managers and Agile Teams to define and prioritize features and user stories based on customer and business needs.
* Continuously align and communicate priorities with cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity before each release or planning session.
* Actively contribute to testing, validation, and improvement activities.
* Participate in team coordination, demo sessions, and continuous improvement events.
* Communicate the value and benefits of the product to both internal and external audiences.
* Support product launch activities, customer demos, and promotional initiatives.
* Contribute to documentation and proposal efforts related to product development and improvement.

### **Your Profile:**

* Experience in product ownership, product management, or related roles.
* Deep understanding of Agile principles and frameworks such as the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe).
* Ability to translate high-level goals into actionable user stories and priorities.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills across cross-functional teams.
* Capacity to balance technical detail with big-picture product vision.
* Keen ability to identify opportunities for improvement and contribute to process enhancements.
* Comfortable presenting ideas and engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
* Passion for continuous improvement and user-centered design.

### **What we can offer you**

A truly global DNA - Everything at Amadeus is global, from our people to our business, which translates into our footprint, processes, and culture.
  
Great opportunities to learn - Learning happens all the time and in many ways at Amadeus, through on-the-job training, formal learning activities, and day-to-day interactions with colleagues.
  
A caring environment - Amadeus fosters a caring environment, nurturing both a fulfilling career and personal and family life. We care about our employees and strive to provide a supportive work environment.
  
A hybrid working model - We want our employees to do their best work, however the hybrid model works best for them.
  
A diverse and inclusive community - We are committed to leveraging our uniquely diverse population to drive innovation, creativity, and collaboration across our organization.
  
A Reliable Company - Trust and reliability are fundamental values that drive our actions and shape long-lasting relationships with our customers, partners, and employees.
  
A critical mission and purpose - At Amadeus, you will be powering the future of travel and pursuing a critical mission and extraordinary purpose.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

  

Amadeus aspires to be a leader in Diversity and Inclusion in the tech industry, enabling every employee to reach their full potential by fostering a culture of belonging and fair treatment, attracting the best talent from all backgrounds, and as a role model for an inclusive employee experience.

  

Amadeus is an equal opportunity employer and committed to an accessible recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, beliefs, disability or any other characteristics protected by law.

**Be aware of recruitment scams**

  

Amadeus Group never charges fees, requests payment, or asks for financial information during recruitment. All legitimate opportunities are communicated solely through official Amadeus channels, including our careers website. Any payment request or outreach via unofficial platforms (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram) should be treated as fraudulent.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, Doctor Experience
job_description:
**About the Company**

Elevate Now is a doctor-led clinical weight loss platform in India. It diagnoses the underlying drivers of weight gain, such as insulin resistance, inflammation and hormonal imbalances, and delivers personalised treatment under medical supervision through a fully online, subscription-based model. Every member is paired with a physician trained in obesity medicine and a dedicated health coach, supported by blood diagnostics and continuous glucose monitoring.

The company has onboarded over 30,000 paying members and is backed by Physis Capital, W Health Ventures, Narayana Health and other early-stage investors.

**Role Summary**

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.
* Spend regular time with physicians to observe how they work, understand their pain points, and turn what you learn into clear product requirements.
* Bring member data such as blood diagnostics, CGM readings, symptoms and progress into a clean, usable view that supports faster clinical decisions.
* Reduce friction and documentation time through smart defaults, templates, automation and, where appropriate, AI assistance.
* Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.
* Work with the clinical leadership team to translate protocols and safety guardrails into product logic, such as prescription checks and flags for follow-up.
* Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.
* Partner with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly, run experiments and iterate on feedback.
* Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

**Requirements (Must-Haves)**

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
* Hands-on experience building products for doctors or clinicians, for example telemedicine or consult platforms, EMR or clinic management tools, or clinical workflow products.
* Experience gathering insight directly from doctors and clinical teams and turning it into shipped product.
* Comfort with sensitive health data and an understanding of why privacy, consent and clinical safety shape product decisions.
* Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to measure usage, efficiency and outcomes.
* Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management, including with senior clinicians.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.
* Exposure to chronic care, metabolic health, obesity medicine or endocrinology workflows.
* Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.
* Familiarity with prescription workflows and the regulatory context for telemedicine in India.
* Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

  
**Benefits**  
  
Why Join Elevate Now

* Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
* Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

**Role Summary**

Doctors are at the centre of the Elevate Now model. The quality of every consult, prescription and follow-up depends on how well the tools around them work. As Product Manager for Doctor Experience, you will own the products that physicians use every day, making it faster and easier for them to review a member’s data, make sound clinical decisions and stay in sync with the health coach and care team.

Success looks like more consults handled per doctor without a drop in quality, less time spent on admin and documentation, higher doctor satisfaction and retention, and better member outcomes and adherence as a result.

 **Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for doctor-facing products, including the consult workflow, patient records and charts, prescriptions, follow-ups and care plans.
* Spend regular time with physicians to observe how they work, understand their pain points, and turn what you learn into clear product requirements.

* Reduce friction and documentation time through smart defaults, templates, automation and, where appropriate, AI assistance.
* Build tools that improve collaboration between doctors, health coaches and support teams, including handoffs, escalations and shared notes.
* Work with the clinical leadership team to translate protocols and safety guardrails into product logic, such as prescription checks and flags for follow-up.
* Define and track metrics such as consult duration, doctor utilisation, documentation time, follow-up completion rate and doctor NPS.
* Partner with engineering, design and data teams to ship quickly, run experiments and iterate on feedback.
* Write clear PRDs and prioritise based on clinical impact, doctor productivity and member outcomes.

* 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager.
* Hands-on experience building products for doctors or clinicians, for example telemedicine or consult platforms, EMR or clinic management tools, or clinical workflow products.

* Comfort with sensitive health data and an understanding of why privacy, consent and clinical safety shape product decisions.
* Working comfort with data (SQL or analytics tools) to measure usage, efficiency and outcomes.
* Clear written communication and strong stakeholder management, including with senior clinicians.

* Experience in healthtech, digital health or a subscription-based care model.
* Exposure to chronic care, metabolic health, obesity medicine or endocrinology workflows.
* Experience building with or evaluating AI tools in a clinical or documentation setting.
* Familiarity with prescription workflows and the regulatory context for telemedicine in India.
* Experience in an early-stage startup where scope is broad and processes are still being built.

  
**Benefits**  
  
Why Join Elevate Now

* Own a high-impact growth charter with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work at the intersection of healthcare, product, and data, where growth improves access to medicines for real patients.
* Collaborate closely with leadership, engineering, and operations in a fast-moving team.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager – Shopify Markets, E-Commerce
job_description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.

We are looking for a Product Manager to help evolve our e-commerce platform across emerging markets, starting with the East Asia Pacific (EAP). Based in India, you will help guide regional platform rollouts, enhance digital consumer experiences, and contribute to the growth of our e-commerce channel in emerging markets. Given the geographically diverse ecosystem, we are looking for a professional who succeeds in ambiguity with experience setting ecommerce strategies and roadmaps for several markets and cultures.

  

As part of the Global Product Management team, and reporting to the Emerging Markets Expansion Director, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality digital commerce experiences that meet local market needs and align with global standards. You will help ship the right customer experience across the end-to-end online shopping journey. You will help shape the way in which people work with our digital shopping experience in the East Asia Pacific region, including Southeast Asia, North Asia, and Australia- New Zealand.

  

**About the Job**

**E-Commerce Platform Execution**

* Analyze consumer feedback and usage metrics to identify key consumer pain points

* Co-develop the product vision, Objectives and Key Results (OKRs), own the roadmap for your product area, and work closely with the stakeholders in the region, including Technical Product Manager, Solutions Architect, and the Business teams in the region. You will oversee the execution of the roadmap.
* Track results towards Goals by managing success metrics through tools, with an understanding of drivers and detractors.
* Identify the controllable input metrics for your product area to achieve sustainable growth.
* Help define the AB Test backlog and building A/B testing plans. Use insights to inform product enhancements.

* Present product plans, benefits and results to senior leadership, partners, external partners and other large audiences.
* Excel in collecting consumer data, internal data, external benchmarks, and our data.
* Assess external options (Shopify Apps) to allow certain features and capabilities required to enhance our site experience.

**Collaboration**

  

* Work with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, and commercial teams to provide cohesive product solutions.
* Track important ecommerce metrics and contribute to product roadmap updates based on evolving business and consumer needs.
* Communicate progress and updates to partners across regions and departments.
* Partner with Engineering to track performance of our sites and prioritise resolution of issues.

**Shopify Rollout & Implementation**

  

* Represent Product and Site Experience during the Shopify implementations in select markets, working with System Integrators (SIs) and local teams to ensure delivery.
* Manage daily project activities, including tracking progress, resolving issues, and ensuring readiness for go-live.
* Provide support for training and documentation to ensure smooth adoption by local teams.

**About You**

  

* 7+ years of experience in product management. E-commerce or consumer-facing digital products experience is good to have.
* Consumer-centric mindset.
* Experience supporting digital commerce rollouts in emerging or complex markets.
* Familiarity with Shopify or similar platforms and experience working with third-party tools and integrations.
* Experience using data and insights to inform product development with experience using data to guide product decisions.

* Work across time zones and cultures.
* Understanding of regional market dynamics in EAP and SAMEA is good to have.

**Benefits**

We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.

Here’s a small snapshot:

* Complimentary preventive health check-up for you & your spouse
* OPD coverage
* Best-in-class leave plan including paternity & family care leaves
* Counseling sessions to prioritize mental well-being
* Exclusive discount vouchers on Levi’s products

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to empowering individuals from all walks of life to achieve their professional goals with us. We actively seek and encourage applications from diverse candidates, including those with disabilities, and offer accommodations throughout the selection process upon request. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.

**LOCATION**
------------

Bengaluru, India

**FULL TIME/PART TIME**
-----------------------

Full time

**Current LS&Co Employees, apply via your Workday account.**
------------------------------------------------------------

author: Hiring Manager
title: Principal Product Manager (Design & Experience)
job_description:
**kAIgentic** is building the intelligence layer for the world's most ambitious enterprises. Headquartered in Singapore with teams in India and Japan, our software platform helps large organizations evolve as fast as technology itself by turning the tacit know-how locked inside their people into safe, governed, AI-powered operations.

The hardest part of enterprise transformation is not strategy. It is execution. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. The outcome is an enterprise that continuously improves.

We are backed by SMBC Group as our founding partner and customer zero, and our platform is already being proven inside one of the most complex, regulated operating environments in the world. That means real problems, real data, and real production impact from Day 1.

You will own one significant part of our product estate end to end: strategy, requirements, delivery and adoption. You will also be kAIgentic’s experience lead across the platform. You will set the principles and patterns every product follows, and own the journeys that cross product boundaries.

Our users do hard, regulated work: confirming how a bank process really runs, redesigning it, and deciding what to automate. The job is not to make that work look simple. It is to remove the labour that shouldn’t be there, keep the expert judgment that should, and make human review mean something.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Define the UX vision that maximizes adoption and quantifiable value across the kAIgentic product suite.
* Architect integrated experience roadmaps that reconcile enterprise governance, legacy workflows, and AI capabilities into seamless user journeys.
* Influence senior leadership, customers, and engineering partners to align feature priorities with reduced cognitive load and heightened trust.
* Represent kAIgentic in customer workshops and industry panels, extracting tacit knowledge that refines the product experience.
* Define measurable adoption and impact metrics, linking user behavior to business outcomes and informing iterative improvement.
* Architect the translation of market, regulatory, and workflow insights into clear product briefs and decision criteria.
* Influence the adoption of AI-enhanced design and research tools within product teams, accelerating evidence-based iteration.

### **Own your product area**

* Set strategy, roadmap and requirements. Write the specs engineering builds from, and make the scope calls, including what to cut.
* Run discovery with the people who do the work. These are experts in banking operations, risk and compliance, often in Japan, and often in situations where you cannot observe the work directly.
* Define success measures that tie user behaviour to outcomes and quality, such as effort per confirmed process, rework and review quality, not adoption alone.

### **Lead experience across the platform**

* Set the experience principles and interaction patterns all products follow. These cover how the product shows confidence and uncertainty, when it asks a person for input, and how review and approval work. Hold the bar in design reviews.
* Own the journeys that cross products, so that what a user confirms in one carries cleanly into the next.
* Design human review that auditors and regulators would accept as meaningful, not a rubber stamp, and define how we measure that it is.
* Design for mixed audiences in the same flow: experts who use the product once or twice, and analysts who work in it daily.
* Prototype with AI tools quickly enough to test ideas with users in days, and raise the team’s practice to match.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* Proven expertise delivering UX-focused product strategy for large-enterprise AI solutions, with a track record of driving adoption and measurable value
* Mastery of product discovery and delivery frameworks, including hypothesis-driven research, PRD authoring, and iterative validation.
* Deep knowledge of enterprise workflow analysis, governance models, compliance constraints, and integration patterns.
* Expertise in AI research fundamentals and the ability to translate model capabilities into user-centric features.
* Strong capability in designing and evaluating user experiences that reduce cognitive load, clarify intent, and build trust.
* Skilled at synthesizing market, regulatory, and customer insights into concise product briefs and strategic direction.
* Exceptional judgment in balancing technical feasibility, security, and scalability with user value.
* Clear, persuasive communication with senior stakeholders, engineering, and customers, both in writing and presentations.
* A track record of owning both a product and its experience in enterprise software used for complex, high-stakes work.
* Judgment to separate essential complexity from accidental complexity. You can show where you removed work and where you deliberately kept it.
* Experience designing oversight of AI or automated decisions, including how model uncertainty and failure reach the user.
* Strong skill at eliciting knowledge from domain experts. Experience in a regulated industry, with banking preferred.
* Hands-on prototyping, including fluency with AI design and prototyping tools. AI-native velocity as a default mode of working
* Clear writing: specs, decision briefs and principles that others can apply without you in the room.
* Influence without authority across product managers, engineering and global stakeholders. Experience with Japanese enterprise clients is a plus.

**Why join kAIgentic?**

We are a global team of builders who thrive in ambiguity, care deeply about the customers we serve, and believe the intelligence layer is how enterprise work will be reshaped over the next decade. We are building the connective tissue that lets large companies operate with the speed of a startup and the trust of an institution.

We look for people who:

* Combine technical excellence with genuine customer empathy.
* Are entrepreneurial and energized by zero-to-one problems with no playbook.
* Lead with ownership, integrity, and collaboration, not titles.
* Want to help define a new category of enterprise AI, not just ship inside an existing one.
* Working here means being surrounded by peers who challenge assumptions, celebrate progress, and build with both courage and care.

**Life at kAIgentic**

* Intelligence layer at the core. You will be shaping the substrate that turns institutional knowledge into governed, production-grade operations. This is enterprise infrastructure with real consequences.
* Innovation at enterprise scale. Startup velocity meets the depth, scale, and stakes of mission-critical, regulated environments. Both are non-negotiable.
* Ownership from Day One. Your work directly shapes the product, the culture, and the outcomes our customers see.
* Learning and growth. You will work alongside seasoned leaders from leading enterprises who have built and scaled global businesses.
* A culture of trust. Psychological safety, transparent disagreement, and disciplined experimentation are how we operate, not slogans on a wall.
* Global collaboration. Teams across Singapore, India, Japan, Europe, and the US, working as one.
* A mission worth the effort. Building something the world has not seen before: anintelligence layer that helps enterprises continuously improve how they run.

We are a global team of builders who thrive in ambiguity, care deeply about the customers we serve, and believe the intelligence layer is how enterprise work will be reshaped over the next decade. We are building the connective tissue that lets large companies operate with the speed of a startup and the trust of an institution.

* Combine technical excellence with genuine customer empathy.

**Life at kAIgentic**

job_description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Make your mark shaping global reference data capabilities in a team committed to Diversity, Inclusion & Opportunity, career growth, and mobility.

As a Product Owner Associate in Client Account Services Change and Strategy within Commercial and Investment Bank, you translate product strategy into clear business and technology outcomes. You partner with product management, technology, and operations stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize the backlog, and drive delivery across the account and standing settlement instruction reference data ecosystem. You apply analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and agile execution to deliver measurable business value, stronger controls, improved efficiency, and an enhanced client experience.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Partner with Product Managers to support execution of the product roadmap and strategic priorities.
* Define business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with stakeholders.
* Prioritize the product backlog by balancing business value, client needs, risk considerations, and technical dependencies.
* Translate complex business requirements into actionable delivery outcomes for technology teams.
* Serve as the primary liaison between product management, technology, and operations throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive end-to-end delivery of product enhancements from concept through production implementation.
* Maintain a healthy backlog and ensure delivery teams are prepared for upcoming sprints and releases.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coordinate testing, user acceptance activities, operational readiness, training, and implementation planning.
* Communicate delivery progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders and senior management.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve data quality, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency using data-driven insights, automation, and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence.

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* Demonstrate experience in product ownership, business analysis, change management, or product delivery within financial services.
* Apply agile methodologies and product development practices to plan and deliver work.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that enable effective delivery.
* Manage a product backlog and support feature delivery across multiple stakeholders.
* Analyze business processes and translate requirements into scalable solutions.
* Influence stakeholders across product, technology, and operations organizations.
* Communicate effectively through concise written and verbal updates.
* Use Jira, Confluence, and Microsoft Office applications to support delivery execution.

**Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* Bring knowledge of markets products, prime brokerage, clearing, custody, or reference data operations.
* Demonstrate familiarity with account and standing settlement instruction reference data processes.
* Deliver experience supporting strategic data or reference data transformation initiatives.
* Use Structured Query Language, Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytical tools.
* Hold agile or project delivery certifications, such as Scrum Product Owner or Scaled Agile Framework Product Owner.
* Complete a bachelor's or master's degree in finance, business, technology, mathematics, statistics, or a related discipline.

*“Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.”*

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Data Product Owner
job_description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. Leads complex product management work, programs, projects, or initiatives across a broad area of responsibility in alignment with product, departmental, functional, and business objectives.  
2. Translates business plans, client needs, product priorities, and functional objectives into actionable recommendations, work plans, and execution approaches.  
3. Provides subject matter expertise on complex products, processes, services, or product life-cycle activities, advising stakeholders on risks, opportunities, dependencies, and potential solutions.  
4. Partners with senior functional leaders, business line stakeholders, Legal, regulatory contacts, and cross-functional partners to interpret business challenges, align priorities, and support strategic and operational decision-making.  
5. Identifies and resolves complex product, process, operational, or client-related issues by analyzing information from multiple sources, applying sound judgment, and leveraging appropriate resources within and outside the function.  
6. Recommends and implements best practices, product enhancements, service improvements, and process changes that strengthen efficiency, quality, control effectiveness, and business outcomes.  
7. Leads or contributes to high-impact initiatives requiring cross-functional coordination, influence, change management, and execution discipline across the product life cycle.  
8. Uses data, metrics, reporting, market or client insights, and performance information to guide decisions, evaluate outcomes, and identify improvement opportunities.  
9. Develops and maintains strong strategic working relationships with peers, senior staff, functional partners, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and sustained performance.  
10. Serves as a technical or functional resource for colleagues by sharing expertise, providing guidance on complex matters, and supporting consistent execution of product-related work.  
11. Performs all duties according to established policies, procedures and regulatory requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS**

* Specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise in own discipline or field, with the ability to apply that expertise to complex product management work.
* Strong business acumen and ability to interpret internal and external business challenges to recommend best practices, product enhancements, or process improvements.
* Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to resolve complex issues using sound judgment and appropriate collaboration or escalation.
* Ability to influence outcomes, negotiate change, and guide stakeholders across areas of responsibility without direct people management authority.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to advise senior functional management and build strategic relationships across the function.
* Experience leading complex initiatives, coordinating cross-functional work, and maintaining execution discipline across multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Knowledge of product management activities, operational processes, controls, risk considerations, and product life-cycle requirements within the area of responsibility.
* Ability to use data, metrics, reporting, and performance information to guide recommendations, measure outcomes, and improve product or process effectiveness.

**EDUCATION/ EXPERIENCE**

Bachelor’s/University degree required; advanced degree preferred. Typically 8+ years of relevant experience, including experience managing complex products, processes, programs, or initiatives; advising stakeholders on product-related matters; and influencing cross-functional outcomes in alignment with business objectives.

**Eligibility - Internal Partners**

  

* 2 years as Senior Consultant/Associate Specialist/Section Manager/Operations Manager to move as a Specialist
* 1 year as Division Manager to move as a Specialist

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

**Job Description**
-------------------

‍

##### **ABOUT TRACXN**

Tracxn is a leading global market intelligence platform tracking 7.9M + private companies across 3,000+ sectors and 50+ geographies. We turn deep data into decision-ready insights, powering deal sourcing, market mapping, and due diligence for 850+ clients worldwide, including VC firms, Private Equity, Investment Banks, and Corporates.

##### **ABOUT THE ROLE**

As a Senior Associate Product Manager at Tracxn, you’ll support the product team in defining requirements, analyzing performance, and executing product initiatives across the lifecycle. You’ll collaborate with design, engineering, and senior PMs to translate ideas into impactful product features.

This role is ideal for early-career professionals eager to learn product fundamentals, work on a global B2B SaaS platform, and grow into a full-fledged Product Manager.

##### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Feature Specification:** Assist Product Managers in defining feature specifications and writing detailed product requirement documents (PRDs).
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with design, engineering, and operations teams to ensure smooth execution across the product lifecycle.
* **Performance Analysis:** Review and analyze key product metrics to track performance and identify improvement areas.
* **Design Support:** Collaborate with the UX team to create wireframes, mockups, and design documentation.
* **Data & Insights:** Use data and API tools (like Postman) to extract insights and validate product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
* **Documentation Management:** Maintain reports, knowledge repositories, and other operational resources for effective tracking and learning.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify workflow bottlenecks and suggest enhancements to improve efficiency and product quality.

##### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* **1–3 years of work experience who have graduated from a Tier 1 college.**
* An engineering background is a must.
* Strong interest in B2B SaaS products and technology, with empathy for users and a problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to structure and analyze ambiguous problems effectively.
* Excellent communication skills to clearly convey ideas through workflows, feature descriptions, and documentation.
* A long-term desire to build a career in Product Management and grow into a full-fledged PM role.
* Preferred: prior exposure to SQL, Postman, or other data/API tools.
* Preferred: internship or project experience in product management, UX, or a related field.

##### **WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT TRACXN**

* Fixed work timings — 9 hrs × 5 days. Respect for personal time; no taking work home.
* A transparent, meritocratic culture where everyone explains the “why” behind their decisions.
* A candid and collaborative environment that values learning, curiosity, and open discussions.
* Managers and mentors who invest in your growth with timely, actionable feedback.
* Continuous learning through real-time projects and cross-functional exposure.

**Ready to apply?**

Send your resume to **careers@tracxn.com** with the subject line

**“Senior Associate Product Manager – Tracxn”**
